title: Senior Integration Engineer - Embedded Analytics (Multi-Tenant SaaS)
description:
Our US-based client is looking for a full-time, remote Senior Integration Engineer - Embedded Analytics (Multi-Tenant SaaS) with 7+ years of experience. The role focuses on designing and building the backend services and integrations that enable secure, scalable, multi-tenant embedded analytics within a SaaS platform.


This role sits at the intersection of application engineering, identity management, and the data platform. The primary focus is on integrating embedded analytics tools into a multi-tenant application with strict tenant isolation, SSO-based access control, and high-concurrency usage patterns.

While AWS QuickSight is the primary BI platform, we are open to candidates with experience embedding other modern, multi-tenant analytics solutions (such as Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Mode, or Superset). The emphasis is on a strong understanding of how embedded analytics work in SaaS environments, rather than on expertise in a single tool.

This is a senior-level role with meaningful influence over analytics architecture, security considerations, and integration standards across the platform.

Our client provides integrated software and marketing solutions for the hospitality industry, specializing in short-term rental management. Their platform provides vacation rental companies with an enterprise-class Property Management System integrating booking, guest communications, and financial reporting systems - all built with partner organization integrations in mind.


Responsibilities

  • Design and implement multi-tenant embedded analytics within customer-facing SaaS applications
  • Build backend services that generate and manage embed sessions, URLs, and permissions dynamically per tenant and user
  • Implement SSO and identity propagation (Auth0, Cognito, OIDC) to enforce tenant-aware access and role-based controls
  • Ensure row-level and dataset-level security is consistently applied across embedded analytics experiences
  • Partner with Analytics Engineers to align datasets, semantic models, and RLS logic with application roles
  • Translate analytics platform constraints into clean, reliable application-facing abstractions
  • Design and maintain tenant-aware APIs that abstract analytics tools behind stable, versioned interfaces
  • Build service-layer patterns that isolate application code from direct BI or warehouse dependencies
  • Implement caching, pagination, throttling, and batching strategies for high-concurrency analytics traffic
  • Ensure APIs gracefully handle tenant onboarding/offboarding and evolving analytics assets
  • Collaborate with the Data Platform Architect to design scalable backend patterns supporting hundreds of tenants
  • Optimize service-to-warehouse and service-to-analytics-tool interactions for latency and cost efficiency
  • Identify and mitigate failure modes in embedded analytics workflows (timeouts, permission drift, stale sessions)
  • Contribute to architecture documentation, integration diagrams, and design reviews
  • Enforce least-privilege access and tenant isolation across all analytics integrations
  • Ensure compliance with PII, data governance, and audit requirements in embedded reporting flows
  • Implement logging and audit trails for analytics access and permission changes
  • Partner with InfoSec to support security reviews and compliance initiatives
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines for integration services and analytics-related configuration
  • Contribute to infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or CloudFormation)
  • Support observability through CloudWatch, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry
  • Improve operational reliability through monitoring, alerting, and runbook development
  • Act as a technical owner for embedded analytics integrations
  • Partner with Product to shape analytics capabilities and roadmap decisions
  • Mentor mid-level engineers on integration patterns, security, and service design
  • Drive standards for analytics integration consistency and developer experience


Required Experience:

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 7+ years of backend or integration engineering experience in SaaS environments
  • Strong experience building backend services in Node.js, Python, or PHP
  • Hands-on experience embedding analytics or BI tools into multi-tenant applications
  • Strong understanding of SSO, OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and identity propagation
  • Experience implementing tenant-aware access controls (RLS, role mapping, dataset isolation)
  • Solid SQL knowledge and experience integrating with data warehouses
  • Proven experience with CI/CD pipelines and cloud-native deployment (AWS or equivalent)


Desired Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or some technical engineering
  • Experience embedding AWS QuickSight in multi-tenant SaaS applications
  • Experience with other embedded analytics platforms (Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Superset, Mode, etc.)
  • Familiarity with row-level security models and permission orchestration
  • Experience with Auth0 or Cognito in analytics contexts.
  • Knowledge of caching layers (Redis) and high-concurrency API design
  • Exposure to data governance, lineage, or analytics access auditing


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

A Atos é líder global em transformação digital, com 112 mil colaboradores em 73 países e receita anual de €12 bilhões. Há mais de 30 anos no Brasil conectando pessoas, negócios e tecnologia para ajudar a melhorar o mundo em que vivemos.

  • Elaborar documentações funcionais, fluxos e especificações.
  • Apoiar testes funcionais, validações e homologações.
  • Atuar com consultas e análises em SQL Server para apoio às demandas de negócio.


Requisitos Técnicos

  • Experiência sólida com EQM (Enterprise Quality Management) .
  • Experiência sólida com ECM (Enterprise Content Management) .
  • Vivência em Gestão de Riscos e Processos de Auditoria .
  • Conhecimento em SQL Server para consultas e análises.

title: Full Stack Engineer  (Vue.js / Angular / C#)
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Developer with 3+ years of experience with Vue.js, React, or Angular, and 5+ years of C# software development experience, to join the software engineering team for our U.S. client. This key individual should have experience making decisions, leading a small development team, and working both independently and as part of a minor, dynamic team where everything you do makes a difference.


The industry-leading client provides business automation and enterprise resource planning (ERP) software to the oil & gas industry. The client's software and services streamline and automate complex processes, such as revenue distribution, billing, order management, production accounting, accounts payable, contract management, and more, for over 1,700 customers across 9 countries.


Responsibilities

  • Coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contribute to team meetings; and troubleshoot development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms
  • Support and develop other developers, providing advice, coaching, and educational opportunities
  • Define web architectures and solutions from business requirements, produce estimates and timelines, and manage delivery against those plans
  • Exhibit excellent communication skills and engage in technical discussions with peers, becoming a trusted technical advisor
  • Work with others to ensure adherence to code standards and best practices
  • Produce reusable, testable, and efficient code
  • Design and implement low-latency, high-availability, and performant applications
  • Implement secure by design standards, including data protection
  • Integration of data storage solutions
  • Ensure application performance, quality, and responsiveness
  • Collaborate with a team to define, design, and ship new features
  • Identify and correct bottlenecks as well as fix bugs


Required Experience

  • Excellent English verbal and written communication skills
  • 3+ years of Vue.js OR React.js and Angular experience
  • 5+ years of C# experience
  • Experience with defining service architectures and solutions from business requirements, producing estimates, and managing delivery against those timelines
  • Experience with SQL Server and NoSQL, such as MongoDB
  • Supports and develops other developers by providing advice, coaching, and educational opportunities
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to engage in technical discussions with peers and become a trusted technical advisor. Work with others to ensure code standards and best practices are followed
  • Experience writing reusable, testable, and efficient code
  • Design and implementation of low-latency, high-availability, and performant applications and services
  • Ability to coordinate requirements, schedules, and activities; contributing to team meetings; troubleshooting development and production problems across multiple environments and operating platforms
  • Strong proficiency working in a containerized deployment environment
  • Experience writing well-formed RESTful APIs


Desired Experience

  • Familiarity with the oil & gas industry applications
  • Experience leading a small to medium-sized team, with assistance from outside parties
  • Understanding the nature of asynchronous programming and its quirks and workarounds
  • User authentication and authorization between multiple systems, servers, and environments
  • Experience with offline storage, threading, and performance tuning
  • Knack for benchmarking and optimization
  • Integration of multiple data sources and databases into one system
  • Understanding fundamental design principles behind a scalable application
  • Implementing automated testing platforms and unit tests
  • Proficient understanding of code versioning tools such as GitHub


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and designated national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

  • We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We focus on providing world-class remote resources who work as valued members of client teams. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Data Annotation & Content Writing Specialist – AI Training
description:
About the Role:


We are looking for detail-oriented and language-savvy professionals to support AI training through high-quality data annotation, content writing, and linguistic evaluation. This role is ideal for individuals who enjoy working with language, structured data, and written content, and who are interested in contributing to the development of AI and NLP systems. You will play a key role in improving model accuracy, clarity, and usability by creating, reviewing, and annotating language data.


Job Title: Data Annotation & Content Writing Specialist – AI Training


Experience Level: Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in any discipline (Linguistics, English, Journalism, Mass Communication, or related fields preferred)


Key Responsibilities:

  • Annotate and label text, audio, or image data according to defined project guidelines.
  • Create, rewrite, and edit content such as prompts, responses, summaries, or examples for AI training.
  • Review and evaluate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, relevance, grammar, tone, and clarity.
  • Identify and flag issues related to ambiguity, bias, factual errors, or inconsistencies in content.
  • Perform quality assurance (QA) checks to ensure annotated and written data meets required standards.
  • Follow detailed instructions and annotation schemas with high attention to detail.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to improve annotation guidelines and content quality.


Qualifications:

  • Strong written English skills with good grammar, vocabulary, and sentence structure.
  • Ability to understand and follow detailed guidelines and workflows.
  • Experience in data annotation, content writing, editing, or reviewing is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with AI, NLP, or language models is a plus but not mandatory.
  • High attention to detail, consistency, and quality.
  • Ability to work independently and meet deadlines.

title: AWS Data Scientist | Senior (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Atuar no desenvolvimento e evolução de soluções de Ciência de Dados e IA Generativa, com foco em arquiteturas RAG;
  • Executar demandas priorizadas pelo Product Owner, realizando detalhamento técnico e definição de abordagens de Machine Learning e GenAI;
  • Desenvolver, sustentar e monitorar pipelines de dados, modelos de ML, APIs e fluxos de IA;
  • Validar performance de sistemas RAG;
  • Implementar pipelines de ingestão e indexação de textos em bancos vetoriais;
  • Construir APIs e fluxos utilizando LangChain, LangGraph e integrações com OpenAI e AWS Bedrock;
  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações conteinerizadas e arquiteturas serverless em AWS e Azure;
  • Produzir visualizações e indicadores para análise crítica e validação de resultados;
  • Garantir aderência às diretrizes de arquitetura, segurança, escalabilidade e boas práticas em nuvem.



Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência sólida com Python e bibliotecas Pandas, scikit-learn, TensorFlow e PyTorch;
  • Experiência prática com Modelos de Linguagem de Grande Escala (LLMs), soluções de IA Generativa e arquiteturas RAG;
  • Conhecimento em métricas de avaliação de NLP e IA (similaridade semântica, BLEU, ROUGE);
  • Experiência com serviços de nuvem AWS, incluindo os serviços: S3, Lambda, RDS, SageMaker, Parameter Store e Secret Manager;
  • Desenvolvimento de pipelines em bancos vetoriais (AWS OpenSearch);
  • Construção de APIs utilizando LangChain e LangGraph;
  • Integrações com OpenAI e AWS Bedrock;
  • Uso de Azure Document Intelligence para processamento de documentos.

Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em DevOps aplicado a ML/IA (MLOps).

title: AI Machine Learning Architect - Relocation to Portugal
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a multinational French company, in Portugal since 2007. We have offices in Lisbon and Oporto and we are a specialized consultant in Management, Implementation, Development and Maintenance of Information Systems. We have more than 150 active partners and we operate in sectors such as banking, insurance, telecommunications, services, energy and transports.


What are we looking for?

  • At least 7 years with a strong background in software engineering, digital platforms, and large-scale technology delivery.
  • Experience defining and executing AI or technology strategies in complex environments.
  • Solid understanding of AI, machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI, with a practical mindset.
  • Experience with Large Language Models and the applied usage patterns.
  • Experience with model monitoring, observability, MLOps tooling, and Agile.
  • Willingness to relocate to Portugal;
  • C1 English is mandatory.


What do we have to offer you?

  • Health Insurance;
  • Feedback&Coffee – the system that includes Aubay’s Performance Management Cycle, with regular moments of feedback and the Career Progression Model;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote/on-site;
  • A Training Academy designed to think of you and your needs. You can count on technical and behavioural training sessions (e-Learning and classroom), Meet&Techs, Webinars and Mentoring;
  • Events and Teambuildings.


What makes us different?

  • Our organizational culture is based on values such as transparency, team spirit, regular feedback and continuous learning;
  • Reference prizes and birthday present;
  • We don’t have a dress code;
  • We know your name and all address each other informally;
  • You will grow in good company. Isn’t this one of the ways in which to develop professionally?


If we got your attention, we now hope to spark your enthusiasm. Ready for the first phase? We are waiting for you:


Personal Data collected by AUBAY PORTUGAL as Data Controller, regarding the identification, contact and professional capabilities of the candidates, in the present procedure, will be processed for the application analysis, having in consideration that the processing is conducted in order to to take the steps, at the request of the data subject, prior to entering into a contract;

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period). The collected data might be transferred or include other processing actitivites, as long as the data subject is informed, in the occurrence of a standard application and selection procedure, for the compliance of legal obligations for the time required by law. For any queries or request regarding personal data protection rights, the Data Subject may contact AUBAY PORTUGAL’s headquarters in Avenida Duque D`Ávila, nº46 em Lisboa or use the DPO’s e-mail - The Data Subject also has the right to file a complaint with the National Data Protection Authority – (please do not include data regarding racial or ethnical origins, political opinions, religion, philosophy, biometrical data, health data, sexual life and orientation, or relating to o criminal convictions and offences.)

title: Staff Data Platform Engineer
description:
No Grupo SBF, reunimos duas grandes forças do esporte no Brasil: a Centauro, maior varejista esportiva multimarcas da América Latina, e a Fisia, distribuidora oficial da Nike no país.


Queremos ser referência em esporte no Brasil e construir um futuro em que cada experiência com o esporte inspire, motive e transforme.


E aí, que tal vestir essa camisa com a gente?


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Buscar inspiração no mercado para trazer novas ideias que possam ser utilizadas para melhorar a plataforma de dados;
  • Atuar ativamente na detecção e na solução de problemas, oportunidades e melhorias relacionados à disciplina de dados na tecnologia;
  • Garantir que o time esteja alinhado com evolução da plataforma e todos entendam as motivações por trás delas;
  • Identificar e antecipar impactos das abordagens em outros produtos cross-squads;
  • Trazer a visão do todo, ao colaborar com o planejamento, acompanhamento e organização de uma dada iniciativa que visa onde outro analista, seja responsável, até a entrega de valor, ajudando a mapear os possíveis riscos e impactos;
  • Orientar, engajar e fomentar proativamente a cultura data driven em toda a Empresa.


Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Sistemas de Informação ou área relacionada;
  • Python;
  • SQL;
  • Conceitos de administração de banco de dados;
  • Conceitos de DW;
  • Shell;
  • Alguma ferramenta/linguagem de IaC: terraform, ansible, puppet;
  • Conceitos de infraestrutura (rede, disco, cpu...);
  • Proficiência com containers (docker, kubernetes);
  • Conceitos de engenharia de software (protocolos de API, SoC, SOLID e etc);
  • Conceitos de sistemas com uso intensivo de dados: lakehouse, data lake, DW MPP;
  • Proficiência com ferramentas de processamento em streaming: kafka, spark, flink;
  • Conceitos de streaming de dados: hopping, session, tumbling;
  • Proficiência com bancos nosql: mongo, cassandra (scyllaDB), druid
  • Conceitos de arquiteturas de sistemas distribuidos: ring, master/worker;
  • Conceitos de machine learning: treino, serving, feature, reinforcement learning;
  • Proficiência com infraestrutura em cloud.

  • Conceitos de administração de banco de dados;
  • Conceitos de DW;
  • Shell;
  • Alguma ferramenta/linguagem de IaC: terraform, ansible, puppet;
  • Conceitos de infraestrutura (rede, disco, cpu...);
  • Proficiência com containers (docker, kubernetes);
  • Conceitos de engenharia de software (protocolos de API, SoC, SOLID e etc);
  • Conceitos de sistemas com uso intensivo de dados: lakehouse, data lake, DW MPP;
  • Proficiência com ferramentas de processamento em streaming: kafka, spark, flink;
  • Conceitos de streaming de dados: hopping, session, tumbling;
  • Proficiência com bancos nosql: mongo, cassandra (scyllaDB), druid
  • Conceitos de arquiteturas de sistemas distribuidos: ring, master/worker;
  • Conceitos de machine learning: treino, serving, feature, reinforcement learning;
  • Proficiência com infraestrutura em cloud.

title: Fechador
description:
APENAS APLIQUE SE VOCÊ TEM EXPERIÊNCIA COMO CLOSER HIGH TICKET E HISTÓRICO DE METAS BATIDAS

Esse cargo exige alta capacidade de comunicação, domínio de técnicas de venda, inteligência emocional e foco em resultados.

O objetivo central é transformar oportunidades em contratos fechados, mantendo uma taxa de conversão saudável e garantindo a satisfação do cliente.


  • Responsabilidades:Conduzir reuniões de vendas consultivas (média 4-6 calls/dia)
  • Fechar contratos de R$10k a R$60k
  • Gerir seu pipeline no Pipedrive com disciplina
  • Nutrir leads com follow-ups estratégicos
  • Participar das rotinas do time (daily, weekly, 1:1)


  • Requisitos:Experiência comprovada como closer (com resultados para mostrar)
  • Comunicação consultiva
  • Disciplina de processo e CRM
  • Proatividade e capacidade de resolver problemas sem precisar de babá
  • Ambição real de ganhar dinheiro
  • Conversão acima de 20%

Nosso papel é aumentar demanda, ticket médio e implementar um departamento comercial terceirizado para nós na clínica. Dessa forma conseguimos garantir o paciente sentado na cadeira da nossa cliente.


Obs: estamos buscando um vendedor de alta performance, que possa entregar 30% de taxa de conversão mínima.


  • Benefícios: R$5.000,00 fixo inicial.
  • Comissão de 3% sobre o valor recebido, podendo chegar a 5% com progressão de taxa de conversão de vendas (média salarial de 12k a 28k).
  • +Bônus por metas batidas.


  • Regime de contratação: PJ.
  • Modelo de trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: Integral.
  • Ferramentas utilizadas: Meet, CRM, planilhas e plataformas de gestão comercial.
  • Apesar do contrato ser PJ, prezamos pela sua exclusividade com nossa empresa.

title: Software Engineer (Backend-focused)
description:
*This is a 6+ month remote contractor position with one of our clients*

*All resumes/CVs need to be submitted in English*


We are seeking a talented Software Engineer with at least 2 years of hands-on experience to join our client’s engineering team, ideally with experience across Node.js, Python, and SQL. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain scalable software applications, collaborating with cross-functional teams to solve complex problems. The ideal candidate is proficient in backend technologies and has a passion for building efficient, reliable systems. Experience in financial services and process automation is a significant advantage, as is familiarity with emerging technologies like LLMs and AI.


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement backend services using Node.js, Python, and SQL databases.
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other engineers to translate requirements into technical solutions.
  • Optimize application performance, scalability, and security.
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following best practices.
  • Troubleshoot and debug issues in production environments.
  • Participate in code reviews, agile ceremonies, and continuous integration/delivery processes.
  • Explore and integrate new technologies, including AI/ML tools where applicable, to enhance product capabilities.
  • Automate workflows and processes to improve efficiency, particularly in data handling and financial operations.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • At least 2+ years of professional software engineering experience.
  • Experience with Node.js.
  • Solid experience with Python for scripting, automation, and backend development.
  • Expertise in SQL for database design, querying, and optimization (experience with MSSQL (Microsoft SQL Server) would be great).
  • Understanding of software development lifecycle, version control (e.g., Git), and RESTful APIs.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and teamwork abilities.

title: Backend Engineer (Golang)
description:
Atividades:

Desenvolver soluções backend robustas, escaláveis e seguras (preferencialmente em Go), atuando no coração da nossa plataforma.

Participar da evolução da arquitetura dos nossos serviços, propondo melhorias e trazendo visão de longo prazo.

Colaborar ativamente na construção de processos técnicos, padrões, boas práticas e automações.

Investigar problemas complexos, propor soluções inteligentes e antecipar riscos e impactos.

Trabalhar lado a lado com Produto, Design e demais áreas para entregar soluções de alto impacto para médicos, pacientes e parceiros.

Garantir qualidade nas entregas, com testes, documentação e preocupação com performance.

Contribuir com ideias, discussões técnicas e revisões de código, elevando o nível técnico do time.

Apoiar a cultura de engenharia com práticas modernas (CI/CD, observabilidade, segurança, escalabilidade).

Aqui você terá autonomia, espaço para construir e liberdade para experimentar. É uma vaga para quem gosta de deixar legado técnico.


Requisitos da vaga:

Cloud & Infraestrutura


Experiência com AWS e boa compreensão de ambientes escaláveis, seguros e de alta disponibilidade.

Vivência com Kubernetes, API Gateway e monitoramento/observabilidade.

Desenvolvimento Backend


Forte conhecimento em Go (ou abertura para aprender rapidamente).

Experiência em criação e manutenção de APIs performáticas e resilientes.

Bancos de Dados


SQL sólido, principalmente em MySQL e/ou PostgreSQL.

Capacidade de modelagem, otimização e entendimento de desempenho.

Arquitetura & Escalabilidade


Experiência com microsserviços, mensageria, event-driven e integrações complexas.

Entendimento sobre escalabilidade horizontal/vertical, HA, tolerância a falhas e boas práticas de arquitetura.

Containers


Uso de Docker no dia a dia para criação de ambientes consistentes.

Mensageria e Eventos


Familiaridade com SQS, Kafka ou similares.

Entendimento de sync vs async, consistência e padrões de comunicação.

Segurança


Conhecimento de OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT e boas práticas de segurança em APIs.


Desejável:

Vivência em ambientes dinâmicos, com múltiplos produtos e frentes de trabalho simultâneas, onde o contexto pode mudar rapidamente e é necessário gerenciar prioridades de forma estratégica e adaptável.

Experiência no setor de saúde ou em ambientes regulados (healthtechs, pharma, planos de saúde, fintechs, etc.).

Conhecimento sobre o ecossistema de saúde brasileiro, prescrições digitais, prontuário eletrônico ou jornada de pacientes e médicos.

Vivência com produtos de mídia digital, marketplaces ou plataformas B2B2C.

Experiência com monetização de produtos digitais, modelos de negócio baseados em dados ou publicidade.

Uso de Docker no dia a dia para criação de ambientes consistentes.

Mensageria e Eventos


Familiaridade com SQS, Kafka ou similares.

Entendimento de sync vs async, consistência e padrões de comunicação.

Segurança


Conhecimento de OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, JWT e boas práticas de segurança em APIs.

Vivência em ambientes dinâmicos, com múltiplos produtos e frentes de trabalho simultâneas, onde o contexto pode mudar rapidamente e é necessário gerenciar prioridades de forma estratégica e adaptável.

Experiência no setor de saúde ou em ambientes regulados (healthtechs, pharma, planos de saúde, fintechs, etc.).

Conhecimento sobre o ecossistema de saúde brasileiro, prescrições digitais, prontuário eletrônico ou jornada de pacientes e médicos.

Vivência com produtos de mídia digital, marketplaces ou plataformas B2B2C.

Experiência com monetização de produtos digitais, modelos de negócio baseados em dados ou publicidade.

title: Human Resources Specialist
description:
About the Job

TurnKey is the #1 Offshore Tech Staffing Firm. We expertly manage all the complexities of staffing exceptional offshore developers – covering everything from recruitment and payroll to legal compliance – so our clients can focus on what they do best: building world-class software. Our TurnKey team is expanding rapidly and spans the globe! With over 300+ employees across Eastern Europe and Latin America (including Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Costa Rica, Uruguay, and Venezuela), we are dedicated to scaling remote software development teams for more than 40 U.S. -based enterprises and startups, such as Ripple, Headspace, R1, Sertifi, YipitData, WorkRamp, and BellXcel.


Our HR Manager will take a hands-on approach to provide essential human resources support to our LATAM team members and clients. This position is vital for executing our people initiatives, delivering excellent internal customer support, and driving HR functional excellence and process improvement. Responsibilities include assisting with various HR tasks such as driving HR initiatives, being a trusted advisor, providing expertise in talent management, employee engagement, and organizational development, supporting managers in building and optimizing HR functions within their teams, and organizing the company’s various events. The HR Manager will report to the HR Lead and work collaboratively with other members of our organization.


Joining our team you will be focusing on

  • Working as an integral part of the TurnKey HR and Operations team, contributing to the company’s strategy, and attending regular HR team and Company meetings.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner with employees (conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings), identifying and anticipating conflicts, resolving difficult situations, maintaining an overall positive atmosphere in the teams.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner to build and maintain excellent relationships with employees in order to deliver the best HR services and demonstrate a collaborative and proactive approach to solving people issues.
  • Coordinate and administer day-to-day employee life cycle functions, including on-boarding, off-boarding, adaptation, and orientation programs.
  • Work closely with clients to provide exceptional service tailored to their needs, partner with the HR and Retention Lead to conduct and lead quarterly HR meetings, and act as an HR advisor to support clients and their teams.
  • Developing and implementing different HR initiatives for the LATAM region.
  • Closely working with either clients or the HR team members from organizing client events (online, offline if needed), workshops, team buildings etc.
  • Working with the LATAM HR People Partner on updating existing presentations as needed, as well as maintaining the HR Notion space up to date.
  • Work/collaborate with core team from different regions in a multicultural environment.


Required Skills

  • A bachelor’s degree in business, HR, or a related field will be a plus
  • Ideally, 3 years of human resources functions experience. Experience in tech companies will be a plus

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Experience with HRIS
  • Experience with Microsoft Office, Google G-Suite and Notion, and other applications

  • Flexibility and adaptability to changing workload
  • Ability to manage multiple assignments and projects simultaneously, be well-organized
  • Attention to detail and high level of accuracy
  • Ability to work in diverse and inclusive environments
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and prioritize workload


Personal competencies

  • Growth Mindset
  • Proactive and enthusiastic
  • Initiative and creativity
  • Achievement drive and optimism
  • Interpersonal and Communication Skills
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills

  • We welcome and celebrate new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule
  • Provided laptop (MacBooks)
  • Opportunity to attend professional development training, certifications, and conferences. We have an Educational budget
  • Private health & dental insurance
  • Free advanced English lessons with budget of $900/year
  • Fully Remote work
  • Free Accounting and legal support required to file taxes
  • Team-building events in various countries across Europe, creating opportunities for the team to connect and explore together

title: Fullstack Developer (Node.js + React + AWS)
description:
About You

You are a hands-on senior engineer who enjoys owning complex systems end-to-end. You are passionate about building scalable, production-grade applications in the cloud and want to contribute to architectural decisions while mentoring others and collaborating with cross-functional teams in a remote-first environment.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher in Computer Science or Software Engineering.
  • 7+ years of experience in software development, with a strong focus on Node.js and TypeScript .
  • Proven experience building full-stack applications using React and TypeScript . Experience with modern React state management patterns.
  • Solid experience designing and operating REST and/or GraphQL APIs .
  • Hands-on experience with AWS serverless services such as Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and S3.
  • Strong knowledge of event-driven architectures in production environments.
  • Strong experience with DynamoDB in production environments, including single-table design, partition/sort key strategies, TTL, and cost-efficient scaling.
  • Experience supporting hybrid architectures , including coexistence with legacy SQL-based systems.
  • Hands-on experience provisioning infrastructure using AWS CDK or other IaC tools (CloudFormation, Terraform)
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (preferably GitHub Actions).
  • Solid understanding of logging, monitoring, and observability using CloudWatch or similar tools.
  • Strong frontend skills with state management patterns such as React Query, Redux, or Zustand.
  • Advanced English proficiency and ability to collaborate effectively in distributed teams.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js and TypeScript.
  • Develop and operate high-performance REST and GraphQL APIs.
  • Implement and evolve event-driven architectures using AWS services such as Lambda, SQS, SNS, and API Gateway.
  • Model and optimize data access patterns in DynamoDB, ensuring performance, scalability, and cost efficiency.
  • Support system evolution by enabling hybrid architectures during migrations from legacy platforms to serverless solutions.
  • Provision and manage infrastructure using AWS CDK and cloud-native best practices.
  • Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines covering linting, testing, building, deployments, and environment management.
  • Ensure production readiness through proper logging, monitoring, alerting, and observability.
  • Build and maintain frontend applications using React and TypeScript, applying clean component architecture and performance optimizations.
  • Collaborate closely with product, backend, and frontend teams to deliver cohesive full-stack solutions.
  • Participate in architectural discussions, perform code reviews, and promote best engineering practices.


Qualifications

  • Strong experience building full-stack apps with React, Node.js and TypeScript .
  • Hands-on experience with AWS serverless : Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB.
  • Experience designing and operating REST APIs (GraphQL is a plus).
  • Experience working with event-driven architectures in production environments.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to join the Prosigliere team.


Description

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Data Engineer to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will be instrumental in designing, building, and maintaining robust and scalable data pipelines and infrastructure. This role requires a deep understanding of data warehousing principles, ETL processes, and database management, with a strong focus on ensuring data quality, accessibility, and performance to support our analytical and reporting needs. You will play a critical role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, empowering our data-driven decision-making across the organization.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable and efficient ETL/ELT pipelines using various data integration techniques to ingest, transform, and load data from diverse sources into our data warehouse.
  • Manage and optimize data models and structures within Snowflake, ensuring strategic organization for performance, cost-efficiency, and ease of consumption by analytics and reporting tools.
  • Administer and optimize PostgreSQL databases, including schema design, query optimization, and performance tuning.
  • Develop, monitor, and troubleshoot data workflows and orchestrations using Apache Airflow to ensure timely and reliable data delivery.
  • Collaborate closely with data analysts, data scientists, and business stakeholders to understand data requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy, and consistency by implementing robust data validation, cleansing, and monitoring processes.
  • Troubleshoot, debug, and optimize existing Tableau reports, and develop new, insightful dashboards and visualizations to meet business needs.
  • Implement and maintain data governance best practices, including data security, privacy, and compliance.
  • Participate in code reviews, contribute to architectural discussions, and promote best practices in data engineering.
  • Continuously evaluate and recommend new technologies and methodologies to improve our data platform and processes.


Technology Requirements

  • Databases: Strong expertise in PostgreSQL and extensive experience with Snowflake data warehousing.
  • Orchestration: Proficient in using Apache Airflow for workflow management and scheduling.
  • ETL/ELT: Proven experience in designing and implementing efficient ETL/ELT processes.
  • Business Intelligence: Hands-on experience with Tableau for report troubleshooting and development.
  • Programming Languages: Strong proficiency in Python for data manipulation, scripting, and automation.
  • Cloud Platforms: Experience with at least one major cloud provider (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and their data-related services (e.g., S3, EC2, Azure Data Lake Storage, Google Cloud Storage, BigQuery).
  • Data Concepts: Solid understanding of data warehousing concepts, dimensional modeling, data lakes, and data marts.
  • Version Control: Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • SQL: Advanced SQL writing and optimization skills.
  • Big Data Technologies (Plus): Familiarity with big data technologies like Spark, Kafka, or similar is a plus.


Profile Requirements

  • Ability to learn quickly and work independently.
  • Strong project management and interpersonal skills.
  • A team player who enjoys collaborating with others.

• Experiência Gerenciador de código GIT Flow.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Natural/Adabas
description:
Profissional com sólida experiência em Natural e Adabas , atuando no mapeamento, análise e interpretação de dados provenientes de soluções que serão descontinuadas. Será responsável por garantir o correto entendimento das estruturas de dados e das regras de exibição implementadas nas aplicações nativas, viabilizando a migração dos dados para uma nova estrutura , mantendo fidelidade ao comportamento atual do sistema.


Responsabilidades:

  • Analisar as bases de dados Adabas , incluindo estruturas de arquivos e descritores, com foco na extração e migração de dados.
  • Avaliar aplicações Natural com front-end nativo , identificando como os dados são transformados, consolidados e apresentados ao usuário.
  • Interpretar e documentar as regras de negócio implementadas no front , mesmo quando não explicitamente documentadas.
  • Traduzir as regras de exibição e transformação de dados para um formato compreensível e reutilizável na nova estrutura de dados .
  • Apoiar a definição do modelo de dados de destino , garantindo que os dados migrados reflitam corretamente a lógica atual de apresentação.
  • Atuar como elo entre as equipes técnicas, de dados e de arquitetura durante o processo de desligamento das soluções Natural/Adabas.


Conhecimentos Técnicos:

  • Forte domínio de Natural (batch e online) .
  • Experiência sólida com Adabas , incluindo leitura de estruturas, descritores e relacionamentos implícitos.
  • Conhecimento em controle de acesso e segurança em ambientes mainframe.
  • Capacidade avançada de leitura, análise e entendimento de código legado Natural .
  • Vivência com processos de extração, transformação e migração de dados .
  • Noções de modelagem de dados para ambientes modernos (relacional, analítico ou outro destino definido).

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Data Science / Machine Learning


Requisitos Obrigatórios:


  • Fluência em inglês ou espanhol.
  • Formação em Ciência da Computação, Matemática, Física, Engenharia ou Estatística.
  • Experiência com Machine Learning, Data Mining e Feature Engineering.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em Python e SQL.
  • Vivência com Redes Neurais, Deep Learning e Processamento de Linguagem Natural (NLP).
  • Conhecimento em APIs de Large Language Models (LLMs) e frameworks como LangChain, OpenAI e Hugging Face.
  • Experiência com ambientes em nuvem, como Azure ou AWS.
  • Conhecimentos em DevOps, MLOps e pipelines de dados e modelos.
  • Experiência com Git, CI/CD, Airflow, Docker e Kubernetes.
  • Boa comunicação verbal e escrita.


Requisitos Desejáveis


  • Mestrado ou PhD em Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência com NLP, processamento de imagens e áudio.
  • Vivência no desenvolvimento de algoritmos escaláveis.
  • Experiência com dados não estruturados e uso de dashboards para visualização e análise.

title: Technical Customer Support Representative (L1)
description:
We are seeking a full-time, remote Technical Customer Support (TCS) Representative with 2+ years of Level 1 support experience, preferably in a doctor's office, veterinary clinic, hospital, or similar healthcare environment. You will use your critical thinking skills to listen to and understand customer needs, offering timely solutions that drive value and customer satisfaction. You will be involved in all aspects of support, including product demonstrations and customer education.

Our client is on a mission to provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is a well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals who thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands of veterinarians in its customer base today (and counting).


Responsibilities

  • Perform core functions of technical support, configuration tasks, and scheduling
  • Maintain high reliability in terms of on-time attendance and availability in assigned channels per shift schedule
  • Provide a timely response and resolution to all inbound customer support (phone, chats, and emails) to understand customer needs and feedback
  • Demonstrate understanding of the client's core products and everyday use cases within the veterinary industry, engaging with customers effectively on their issues
  • Identify the root cause of customer issues, understand the steps to replicate and solve the problem within the client's means, and escalate when not
  • Stay updated on product knowledge to help build and curate knowledge articles
  • Deliver excellent customer experience to clinics and pet owners
  • Ensure root cause and solution are provided consistently
  • Provide all-channel support during designated shift hours:
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 AM - 4 PM CT (preferred) or 9 AM - 6 PM CT
  • Provide live channel (phone, chat) support during periodic flex times (1 to 2 times per month):
  • Monday to Friday
  • 7 - 8 AM CT or 5 - 6 PM CT
  • Fridays
  • 1 - 2 PM CT or 3 - 4 PM CT


Required Experience

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
  • 2+ years of Level 1 support for a software-as-a-service (SaaS) product
  • Experience with Zendesk Talk, Messaging, and Support or similar platforms
  • Great attention to detail and strong organizational skills
  • Proven experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently or within a broader team
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Preferred Experience

  • Experience supporting clinician environments, including veterinarian clinics, doctor offices, or hospitals


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter, think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with innovative and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Let's learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual, with no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), one floating day, three sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent who enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

description:

Our client provides a cloud-based, ERP platform to hundreds of energy industry customers delivering market-leading field service management, field data gathering, transportation, production, accounting, and land software solutions.   • Provide incident queue management

  • Help manage complex issues and drive escalations to resolution
  • Build and demonstrate cross-application knowledge among the client's core application modules

  • Gain experience in the oil and gas industry; including economic, accounting, and finance knowledge

  • Excellent English verbal and written skills
  • 3 to 5 years of Level 3 software support experience
  • Basic to intermediate SQL skills
  • Proficiency in using Microsoft Office Suite
  • A drive to continue learning in the energy business and the client's software
  • Advanced problem-solving skills
  • Ability to triage and actively manage a support queue
  • Innate passion for customer service
  • Dependability and ability to manage as well as prioritize concurrent tasks
  • Must be available for an on-call rotation
  • Ability to work U.S. CST business hours
  • Must be a self-starter and resourceful
  • Ability to work independently or as part of a team
  • Proven experience working effectively in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • Experience creating manuals, training documentation, and interactive training materials for software applications
  • Experience providing software support and troubleshooting for SaaS applications

title: SDR Closer (SaaS)
description:
A Jupiter - Segurança Cibernética e Tecnologia é uma empresa brasileira que fornece soluções inovadoras para segurança cibernética e automação de processos. Com mais de 10 anos de experiência, nosso time altamente qualificado desenvolve e implementa soluções personalizadas alinhadas às melhores práticas de mercado para atender às necessidades específicas de diversos setores. Nossos serviços abrangem desde consultoria em arquitetura de segurança até automação de processos, segurança cibernética ofensiva e defensiva, e gestão de identidades e acessos. Priorizamos a eficiência e a inovação, fornecendo suporte especializado e flexível para garantir a proteção e o crescimento sustentável dos negócios de nossos clientes.


Buscamos um(a) Closer B2B (SaaS), com perfil hands-on, autonomia e foco em resultado. Essa pessoa será responsável por conduzir o ciclo completo de vendas de uma solução SaaS, atuando de forma consultiva desde o diagnóstico até o fechamento, com responsabilidade sobre forecast, ritmo comercial e conversão.

É uma posição estratégica para quem já viveu rotinas de crescimento, estruturação e evolução de processo comercial — e gosta de melhorar o jogo enquanto vende.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir reuniões consultivas e diagnósticos com decisores (discovery e qualificação).
  • Apresentar a solução SaaS traduzindo funcionalidades em valor de negócio (impacto, risco, eficiência, ROI).
  • Construir, ajustar e negociar propostas comerciais personalizadas (escopo, planos, condições e prazos).
  • Gerenciar pipeline e follow-ups com disciplina em CRM (organização, próximos passos, previsibilidade e cadência).
  • Fechar contratos e garantir a transição estruturada para jurídico e pós-vendas/onboarding.
  • Contribuir com melhorias contínuas de processo, discurso, playbook e funil de vendas com base em dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas consultivas B2B, preferencialmente com SaaS (ciclo de venda, negociação e fechamento).
  • Perfil hands-on, alta autonomia e responsabilidade por metas.
  • Capacidade de conduzir diagnósticos, lidar com objeções e negociar contratos de média complexidade.
  • Organização e disciplina na gestão de pipeline, forecast e cadência comercial.
  • Experiência prática com CRM (ex.: Pipedrive, Salesforce, RD Station CRM, Dynamics, Zoho ou similares).
  • Adaptabilidade para atuar em ambiente dinâmico e em evolução de processos.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em reestruturação/otimização de processos comerciais e construção de playbooks.
  • Vivência com SaaS, inteligência de mídia, comunicação, reputação, dados, marketing ou martech.
  • Escrita persuasiva e abordagem consultiva orientada a dados.
  • Conhecimento de SCRUM/Agile (ex.: rotina com squads, cerimônias, priorização e entregas iterativas).
  • Formação em Publicidade, Marketing, Comunicação, Administração, Gestão Comercial, Vendas ou áreas correlatas.


Modalidade

  • PJ | Remoto

  • Noções de Angular 7 .

title: Technical Product Manager
description:
Location:

Remote (Brazil, United Kingdom, Ireland)


We’re seeking a Technical Product Manager to lead our R&D team’s initiatives across AI tooling, SaaS development, data science projects, and API integrations. This role focuses on transforming ideas into actionable projects while building the resources and infrastructure needed for innovation.


About LOCOMOTIVE

LOCOMOTIVE Agency is an award-winning digital marketing firm based in Apex, North Carolina, specializing in enterprise technical SEO and paid media services. Founded in 2012, they serve Fortune 100/250 companies, mid-sized vertical leaders, and funded start-ups. Following their 2024 acquisition of IMS Marketing in Ireland, LOCOMOTIVE expanded their international presence and service offerings. The agency has earned multiple U.S. Search Awards, including “Best SEO Agency” (2019, 2022) and both “Best SEO Agency” and “Best PPC Agency” in 2023.


Core Responsibilities

  • Take new project ideas from concept through research, planning, and requirements definition to successful execution
  • Organize and prioritize initiatives across AI, SaaS, data science, and API development projects
  • Develop internal team capabilities while identifying and sourcing external specialists for niche technical needs
  • Assist with minor code issues and pull requests reviews related to maintaining deployed technologies and integrations 
  • Lead agile ceremonies and establish processes suited for experimental R&D work where failure is part of learning
  • Bridge technical teams with business stakeholders to ensure alignment on project value and feasibility
  • Manage vendor relationships and evaluate external resources for specialized development needs
  • Document learnings from both successful and unsuccessful experiments to inform future initiatives
  • Coordinate resource allocation across multiple concurrent projects with varying technical requirements


Technical Requirements

  • 3+ years of combined product and project management experience in technical environments
  • Experience managing AI/ML, SaaS, data science, or API development projects
  • Strong understanding of agile methodologies with ability to adapt for research environments
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (Google Cloud Platform preferred) and modern development workflows
  • Experience with technical vendor evaluation and management
  • Understanding of API architecture, versioning, and maintenance requirements
  • Ability to assess technical requirements and identify appropriate resources (internal or external)
  • Experience with project management tools (Linear.app experience a plus)
  • Comfortable working with Git/GitHub workflows and technical documentation
  • Knowledge of marketing technology ecosystems (HubSpot experience beneficial)


Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in software development, data science, or technical fields
  • Experience managing projects in high-uncertainty research environments
  • Track record of building and developing technical teams
  • Experience with deployment platforms (Render, Fly.io)
  • Understanding of SEO and digital marketing workflows
  • Previous agency or consulting experience
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or related field
  • Certifications in agile methodologies or project management


Personal Qualities

  • Resourceful problem-solver who knows how to find the right expertise for any challenge
  • Comfortable with experimental environments where not every project succeeds
  • Strong organizational skills with attention to detail
  • Excellent communication abilities across technical and non-technical audiences
  • Self-directed with the ability to manage multiple priorities independently
  • Curious mindset with genuine excitement about emerging technologies
  • Collaborative approach to team development and knowledge sharing
  • Pragmatic decision-maker who balances innovation with practical delivery


Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience
  • Flexible, fully remote work environment
  • Paid vacation and holidays
  • Annual end-of-year break (Christmas to New Year’s)
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Latest development tools and hardware


Location

Fully remote position open to candidates in:

  • Brazil
  • United Kingdom
  • Ireland


Must be able to overlap with primary business hours in EST time zone.

title: Analista de dados
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Há mais de 20 anos mercado, somos uma consultoria estratégica de Inovação e Transformação Digital. Nossa especialidade é impulsionar as demandas de nossos clientes, integrando processos, pessoas e tecnologia de alta performance.


Data Analyst - Sr

Required experience

Required experience Recommended experience: 5-7 years of hands-on BI application development experience

Ability to identify technical, security risks and propose mitigation actions

Hands on experience of Configuration & Release Management

Practices Participate in software modification during integration testing

Understand requirements from the stakeholders and documenting such requirements.

Transpose business requirements into data solutions.

Propose changes to improve efficiency and/or reduce operation or maintenance cost;

Create good practices and propose improvements

Gather functional and non functional, including information security requirements from the stakeholders and document such requirements.


Mandatory Skills

Advanced Data Analysis and Data Modeling skills.

Strong expertise SQL and it’s application on distributed data processing frameworks (e.g., Spark). Practical knowledge of Python development for data pipelines.

Strong expertise on developing Data Visualization apps in Power BI, including advanced DAX for complex measures’ creation, semantic models, data flows, datasets and deployment pipelines. Solid background in Git-based version control. Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines.

Experience with Azure DevOps.

Understanding of Databricks Unity Catalog, clusters, and SQL Warehouses. Comfort using CLI tools and scripting (e.g., Azure CLI, Databricks CLI).

Familiarity with app registrations and service principals.


Recommended Skills

Excellent Communication:

Ability to interact effectively with international teams, business, and IT Knowledge of the industrial, automotive, or logistics sectors.

Experience working with European teams. Experience with Azure Data Factory.

Experience with Databricks.

Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure Functions and Azure Web Apps.

Background in API integrations and JSON-based messaging.


Degree

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.


Idioma:

Imprescindível inglês fluente para atuar com equipes internacionais


CLT - obrigatório

Benefícios:

Vale Refeição - Cartão Swille

title: AI/ML Engineer Tech Lead Manager
description:
Nosso cliente, uma empresa de tecnologia focada em soluções digitais e inteligência artificial para o setor industrial, está buscando um(a) AI/ML Engineer Tech Lead Manager para se unir a equipe:


Principais responsabilidades:


  • Liderar e desenvolver um time de Data Scientists.
  • Garantir planejamento, priorização e execução eficientes das iniciativas de dados e IA.
  • Atuar em parceria próxima com Produto e Engenharia para alinhar soluções técnicas às necessidades do negócio.
  • Contribuir de forma hands-on em experimentação, decisões de arquitetura e desenho de soluções de ML e IA.
  • Assegurar padrões elevados de engenharia e ciência de dados (reprodutibilidade, documentação e deploy).
  • Identificar oportunidades de uso de IA, traduzindo problemas reais em soluções escaláveis e sustentáveis.
  • Promover uma cultura de melhoria contínua, entrega incremental de valor e compartilhamento de conhecimento.


Quem buscamos:


Buscamos um profissional com formação em áreas de Ciência, Tecnologia, Engenharia, Matemática ou correlatas, experiência prévia liderando times de Data Science e forte atuação prática em Machine Learning, IA, Python e SQL. É essencial ter vivência no desenvolvimento e deploy de soluções em produção, além de boa comunicação para interagir com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos. Inglês é obrigatório. Experiência com LLMs, cloud e/ou ambientes industriais será considerada um diferencial.

title: Arquiteto de Infraestrutura (Plataforma Mainframe)
description:
Procuramos Analista de Suporte Mainframe SR que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira.


Modalidade de Trabalho: Atuação em formato Presencial em São Paulo ou Brasília, de 23:00 às 07:00 (Segunda/Sexta).


Perfil que Buscamos:

- Pessoa Responsável por gerar e customização do sistema operacional em suporte, desenvolvimento, homologação e produção (MVS/ESA OS/390 e Z/OS).

- Instalação de sistema operacional e softwares de apoio ao Z/OS com o uso de SMP/E e Suporte a produtos de apoio a equipes de produção, desenvolvimento e produção.


Nesta função você irá:

- Coletar e analisar informações para desenvolvimento e alteração de sistemas.

- Planejar e implantar expansões de hardware I/O usando a ferramenta HCD - Hardware Configuration Definition.

- Planejar e implementar novas Lpares no complexo operacional.

- Estudo, planejamento e implementação de software voltado ao gerenciamento de Storage.

- Participação do grupo de estudo e implementação do DFSMSHSM em ambiente de suporte, desenvolvimento e produção.

- Definição de catalogos ICF CATALOG, bem como definição e manutenção de aliases e reorganização de catalogos com e sem a ferramenta TACM.

- Analisar performance do ambiente produtivo e sugerir alterações que possam maximizar e otimizar os recursos dando suporte a equipe de performance utilizando a ferrameta MAINVIEW.

- Implantação de manutenção de CF Coupling Facility e estruturas HMC: Criar e alterar configurações de hardware e profiles de ativação de CPU.


Necessário ter:

- Formação superior completa na área de TI.

- Experiência como Analista de Suporte na plataforma Mainframe.

- Atendimento de incidentes.

- Garantir o SLA contratado, manter a disponibilidade da infraestrutura funcionando 24×7 em todos os sites.

- Atuação e customização de Sistema Operacional zOS 2.2/2.4/3.1.

- Especialista da Plataforma Mainframe.

- Domínio de software básico IBM: z/OS (RACF, WLM, OMVS, JES3, TCPIP, VTAM, DFSMS, DFHSM e SMP/E).

- Domínio do software EOS ENTERPRISE OUTPUT SOLUTION, Gerenciador de Relatórios.

- Domínio do software GFS/AFM, Gerenciador de Fitoteca.

- Domínio do software GFS/BETA zSecurity, administrador de RACF.

- Programação em linguagens: Assembler, REXX e JCL.

- Coleta e monitoramento pelo software BMC Mainview.

- Noções básicas de Bancos de Dados DB2 e IMS/DB.

- Noções básicas de arquitetura de rede TCP/IP.


O que você pode esperar de nós

- Flexibilidade de trabalho, promovendo o equilíbrio entre sua vida pessoal e profissional. Desenvolvimento profissional e evolução constante das suas competências, sempre de acordo com os seus interesses.Um ambiente colaborativo, diverso e inovador, que incentiva o trabalho em equipe.


O que oferecemos?

SONDA Academy: uma plataforma de aprendizado que busca maximizar seu desenvolvimento profissional.Trabalho híbrido. Na SONDA sabemos que a flexibilidade é importante para o seu bem-estar, é por isso que contamos com jornadas presenciais e de teletrabalho.SONDA Wellness, um programa que busca apoiá-lo no equilíbrio da sua vida pessoal e profissional, promovendo uma série de iniciativas focadas na sua saúde física, menta e social.E muito mais!


+ Diversidade + Inclusão = Inovação e colaboração.


Na SONDA estamos comprometidos com a diversidade. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, garantindo que os talentos possam trabalhar em um ambiente positivo que os convide a desenvolver sua carreira profissional com igualdade de oportunidades. Sabermos que a diversidade é um elemento fundamental para impulsionar a inovação, é por isso que buscamos candidatos com base em suas qualificações profissionais, independentemente de raça, cor da pele, religião, idade, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade ou deficiência.

  • Mapear e envolver stakeholders;
  • Otimizar as respostas aos riscos;
  • Adequar o projeto de acordo com o contexto, adotando uma capacidade de adaptação e resiliência;
  • Realizar acompanhamento ativo de pendências;
  • Incluir critérios de aceitação nas entregas para garantia da qualidade e atendimento de expectativas
  • Executar outras tarefas correlatas, do mesmo grau de dificuldade mediante solicitação do superiorimediato


Buscamos alguém que apresente:

title: Software Engineer Sênior - Vaga afirmativa para pessoas LGBTQIAPN+
description:
A abertura atual é para a Artefact do Brasil, mas estamos em modelo Free Office.
Quem nós somos

Nós da Artefact Brasil acreditamos e vivemos uma cultura com base na empatia!

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas.

Temos como nosso compromisso a construção de um ambiente mais diverso e inclusivo, porque a empatia é para todas as pessoas, independentemente de etnia, cor, gênero, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou crença religiosa.

Queremos conosco mentes e corações incríveis! Venha ser Artefact !
Quais serão suas atividades;
Como Software Engineer Sênior na Artefact, você será uma peça-chave do nosso time de tecnologia, contribuindo ativamente para o desenho, desenvolvimento e evolução de aplicações web complexas que apoiam nossos projetos de dados e insights em múltiplas indústrias.
Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. title: Technical Support Engineer - Level 3 (VMWare)
description:
About the Company

Park Place Technologies is a global data center and networking optimization firm. Powered by the world’s largest on-the-ground engineering team, a robust group of advanced engineers and our fully staffed, 24x7x365 Enterprise Operations Center, we offer a robust portfolio of IT solutions to optimize networking and data center Uptime and performance. As the industry leader, our 2500 Park Place Associates provide support to 21,000+ customers in more than 180+ countries. We are proud to service 90% of Fortune 500 companies and 40% of Forbes 100 clients. Our company’s strength and success are a credit to our Associates, and Park Place Life is how we communicate and deliver our culture internally. We have been awarded as a NorthCoast 99 “Best Workplace” winner for 14 consecutive years in recognition of our employee commitment. Park Place Life is about collaboration, responsiveness, diversity, and integrity, and represents everything that makes our company great and our culture unique.


Technical Support Engineer Level 3 – Wintel/VMWare


The Technical Support Engineer L3 is responsible for proactively responding to the technical challenges and requirements for customers within the Managed Services environments. The Managed Services department is primarily focused on delivering the whole solutions lifecycle, including; Presales, design, implementing, supporting, maintaining and decommissioning data centre solutions to ensure the continuity of business operations for all customers. This role is expected to work with other members of the managed services and technical teams in implementing and supporting solutions for new and existing customers.


What you’ll be doing:

· Deliver support solutions for Managed Services customers in line with industry best practice to deliver continual service improvement over the whole service lifecycle.

· Work closely with WINTEL Team Lead to ensure new customers are migrated with seamless handover / transition from onboarding into the steady state managed service environment.

· Implementing new and refreshed managed service solutions for hosted customer environments.

· Dynamically monitor, manage and improve managed service environments. Identifying and resolving root cause of issues and ensuring continual service availability.

· Strive for continual service improvement based on a desire to become a world class managed service provider.

· Contribute proactively to new service development.

· Deliver a high-performance culture in the team with a focus on teamwork, service excellence and ownership for resolving customer issues.

· Guarantee operational procedures and practices are well defined, documented and consistently applied.

· Ensure quality, up-to-date documentation exists for all service arrangements.

· Other duties assigned


What we’re looking for:

· Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a 3rd line support or administration role, predominantly

working within data centre services and infrastructure.

· Minimum of 8 years’ experience with virtualization technologies i.e. VMware or Hyper-V

· Minimum of 7 years’ experience with Server operating systems; Windows Server, Linux or Unix.

· Detailed technical understanding of other datacenter technologies including storage, backup, disaster recovery and security.

· Storage connectivity experience within vCenter for troubleshooting

· OEM knowledge-based competencies, preferred.

· Ability to understand and navigate technical situations with strong problem-solving and remedy skills.

· Experience in technical project management.

· Experience in producing low-level technical designs and supporting implementation documentation.

· Experience in performing technical presentations and customer workshops.

· Fluent in English


Bonus Points:

· Vendor certifications a plus (current VCP, MCS Server Virtualization with Windows Server Hyper-V and System Center) – may be required for specific platform support needs.

· Project Management Certification (Prince2 or equivalent)


Education:

· Bachelor’s degree required.


Travel:

· 5-10%


If you are a qualified individual with a disability or a disabled veteran, you may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to access job openings or apply for a job on this site as a result of your disability. You can request reasonable accommodations by

calling .


Park Place Technologies is an Equal Opportunity Employer M/F/D/V.


Park Place Technologies has an in-house recruiting team that focuses exclusively on the hiring needs of our company. We are not currently accepting additional third-party agreements or unsolicited resumes. If you would like to be considered as a preferred partner with Park Place

Technologies, please submit your detailed information to Any CVs submitted directly to hiring managers will be considered unsolicited and become the property of Park Place Technologies

title: Technical Support Engineer - Level 3 (VMWare)
description:
About the Company

Park Place Technologies is a global data center and networking optimization firm. Powered by the world’s largest on-the-ground engineering team, a robust group of advanced engineers and our fully staffed, 24x7x365 Enterprise Operations Center, we offer a robust portfolio of IT solutions to optimize networking and data center Uptime and performance. As the industry leader, our 2500 Park Place Associates provide support to 21,000+ customers in more than 180+ countries. We are proud to service 90% of Fortune 500 companies and 40% of Forbes 100 clients. Our company’s strength and success are a credit to our Associates, and Park Place Life is how we communicate and deliver our culture internally. We have been awarded as a NorthCoast 99 “Best Workplace” winner for 14 consecutive years in recognition of our employee commitment. Park Place Life is about collaboration, responsiveness, diversity, and integrity, and represents everything that makes our company great and our culture unique.


Technical Support Engineer Level 3 – Wintel/VMWare


The Technical Support Engineer L3 is responsible for proactively responding to the technical challenges and requirements for customers within the Managed Services environments. The Managed Services department is primarily focused on delivering the whole solutions lifecycle, including; Presales, design, implementing, supporting, maintaining and decommissioning data centre solutions to ensure the continuity of business operations for all customers. This role is expected to work with other members of the managed services and technical teams in implementing and supporting solutions for new and existing customers.


What you’ll be doing:

· Deliver support solutions for Managed Services customers in line with industry best practice to deliver continual service improvement over the whole service lifecycle.

· Work closely with WINTEL Team Lead to ensure new customers are migrated with seamless handover / transition from onboarding into the steady state managed service environment.

· Implementing new and refreshed managed service solutions for hosted customer environments.

· Dynamically monitor, manage and improve managed service environments. Identifying and resolving root cause of issues and ensuring continual service availability.

· Strive for continual service improvement based on a desire to become a world class managed service provider.

· Contribute proactively to new service development.

· Deliver a high-performance culture in the team with a focus on teamwork, service excellence and ownership for resolving customer issues.

· Guarantee operational procedures and practices are well defined, documented and consistently applied.

· Ensure quality, up-to-date documentation exists for all service arrangements.

· Other duties assigned


What we’re looking for:

· Minimum of 8 years’ experience in a 3rd line support or administration role, predominantly

working within data centre services and infrastructure.

· Minimum of 8 years’ experience with virtualization technologies i.e. VMware or Hyper-V

· Minimum of 7 years’ experience with Server operating systems; Windows Server, Linux or Unix.

· Detailed technical understanding of other datacenter technologies including storage, backup, disaster recovery and security.

· Storage connectivity experience within vCenter for troubleshooting

· OEM knowledge-based competencies, preferred.

· Ability to understand and navigate technical situations with strong problem-solving and remedy skills.

· Experience in technical project management.

· Experience in producing low-level technical designs and supporting implementation documentation.

· Experience in performing technical presentations and customer workshops.

· Fluent in English


Bonus Points:

· Vendor certifications a plus (current VCP, MCS Server Virtualization with Windows Server Hyper-V and System Center) – may be required for specific platform support needs.

· Project Management Certification (Prince2 or equivalent)


Education:

· Bachelor’s degree required.


Travel:

· 5-10%

title: SDR Closer (SaaS) Food Service
description:
A Jupiter - Segurança Cibernética e Tecnologia é uma empresa brasileira que fornece soluções inovadoras para segurança cibernética e automação de processos. Com mais de 10 anos de experiência, nosso time altamente qualificado desenvolve e implementa soluções personalizadas alinhadas às melhores práticas de mercado para atender às necessidades específicas de diversos setores. Nossos serviços abrangem desde consultoria em arquitetura de segurança até automação de processos, segurança cibernética ofensiva e defensiva, e gestão de identidades e acessos. Priorizamos a eficiência e a inovação, fornecendo suporte especializado e flexível para garantir a proteção e o crescimento sustentável dos negócios de nossos clientes.


Buscamos um(a) Closer B2B (SaaS), com perfil hands-on, autonomia e foco em resultado. Essa pessoa será responsável por conduzir o ciclo completo de vendas de uma solução SaaS, atuando de forma consultiva desde o diagnóstico até o fechamento, com responsabilidade sobre forecast, ritmo comercial e conversão.

É uma posição estratégica para quem já viveu rotinas de crescimento, estruturação e evolução de processo comercial - e gosta de melhorar o jogo enquanto vende.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir reuniões consultivas e diagnósticos com decisores (discovery e qualificação).
  • Apresentar a solução SaaS traduzindo funcionalidades em valor de negócio (impacto, risco, eficiência, ROI).
  • Construir, ajustar e negociar propostas comerciais personalizadas (escopo, planos, condições e prazos).
  • Gerenciar pipeline e follow-ups com disciplina em CRM (organização, próximos passos, previsibilidade e cadência).
  • Fechar contratos e garantir a transição estruturada para jurídico e pós-vendas/onboarding.
  • Contribuir com melhorias contínuas de processo, discurso, playbook e funil de vendas com base em dados.


Requisitos

  • Experiência comprovada em vendas consultivas B2B, preferencialmente com SaaS (ciclo de venda, negociação e fechamento).
  • Perfil hands-on, alta autonomia e responsabilidade por metas.
  • Capacidade de conduzir diagnósticos, lidar com objeções e negociar contratos de média complexidade.
  • Organização e disciplina na gestão de pipeline, forecast e cadência comercial.
  • Experiência prática com CRM (ex.: Pipedrive, Salesforce, RD Station CRM, Dynamics, Zoho ou similares).
  • Adaptabilidade para atuar em ambiente dinâmico e em evolução de processos.


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em reestruturação/otimização de processos comerciais e construção de playbooks.
  • Vivência com SaaS, inteligência de mídia, comunicação, reputação, dados, marketing ou martech.
  • Escrita persuasiva e abordagem consultiva orientada a dados.
  • Conhecimento de SCRUM/Agile (ex.: rotina com squads, cerimônias, priorização e entregas iterativas).
  • Formação em Publicidade, Marketing, Comunicação, Administração, Gestão Comercial, Vendas ou áreas correlatas.
  • Diferencial: experiência com sistemas (SaaS/ERP/PDV/CRM/automação) e/ou vendas para empresas de food service (bares, restaurantes, redes, dark kitchens, franquias, distribuidoras e operações multiunidade), entendendo rotinas operacionais, dores de atendimento, controle, compliance e indicadores do setor.


Modalidade

PJ | Remoto
