title: 3D Architectural Visualization Artist (Unreal Engine)
description:
Company Description

Clay is an immersive operating system designed to modernize real estate development, leasing, and marketing processes for multifamily and single-family rental developers. By integrating 3D visualization, AI-driven sales tools, and behavioral insights, Clay centralizes operations and enhances personalized experiences for renters and buyers. The platform supports property teams in lead generation, virtual walkthroughs, and improving conversion rates with a streamlined leasing process. Clay collaborates with innovative real estate developers and operators across North America to improve the way communities are launched, leased, and scaled.


Role Description

We’re looking for a 3D Architectural Visualization Artist with strong Unreal Engine experience to help us create real-time interior apartment walkthroughs. This is not game development. Our work focuses on residential interiors used for sales and marketing.


Our pipeline combines AI-assisted modeling, Blender, Adobe Substance, and Unreal Engine, along with internal tools that automate floor plans and layouts. You’ll be trained on our internal tooling.


Our Workflow

  • Interior geometry is created using AI tools and/or manual modeling in Blender
  • Materials and textures are authored in Adobe Substance (Painter/Designer)
  • Scenes are assembled, lit, and optimized in Unreal Engine (UE5)
  • Internal Unreal-connected tools help generate floor plans and unit layouts → Full training provided


Experience working in structured pipelines is important. You will ensure the delivery of visually compelling content, maintain accuracy in architectural representation, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to bring designs to life. Proficiency in Unreal Engine will be a crucial aspect of daily tasks.


Qualifications

  • Create high-quality interior apartment scenes in Unreal Engine
  • Work with AI-generated and hand-modeled assets
  • Author and apply realistic PBR materials using Adobe Substance
  • Set up interior lighting (Lumen, reflections, exposure)
  • Build clean, optimized real-time walkthroughs
  • Maintain visual consistency across multiple units and projects
  • Learn and use internal tools connected to Unreal Engine


Requirements

Must-have

  • Strong experience with Unreal Engine (UE5 preferred)
  • Architectural visualization experience (interiors required)
  • Proficiency in Blender or similar DCC tools
  • Experience with Adobe Substance for materials/textures
  • Solid understanding of real-time lighting and performance optimization
  • Portfolio showing Unreal Engine interior walkthroughs


Nice-to-have

  • Experience working with AI-assisted modeling workflows
  • Datasmith workflow experience
  • Apartment or residential interior projects
  • Basic Blueprint knowledge
  • Experience working with internal or proprietary tools

Our pipeline combines AI-assisted modeling, Blender, Adobe Substance, and Unreal Engine, along with internal tools that automate floor plans and layouts. You’ll be trained on our internal tooling.


Our Workflow

  • Interior geometry is created using AI tools and/or manual modeling in Blender

  • Learn and use internal tools connected to Unreal Engine

Must-have

Nice-to-have

title: Account Executive Brazil
description:
Localização


Brasil (remoto)

Disponibilidade para reuniões presenciais estratégicas


Sobre a Cybervision


A Cybervision é uma plataforma moderna de PAM (Privileged Access Management), criada para empresas que precisam de segurança imediata, visibilidade total e controle real sobre acessos privilegiados. Nosso foco é entregar valor rápido, com implantação ágil, monitoramento ativo e abordagem orientada a risco e negócio.


 Responsabilidades

• Atuar na abertura de novos clientes no mercado brasileiro, com foco em médias e grandes empresas

• Conduzir o ciclo completo de vendas: prospecção, diagnóstico, apresentação, negociação e fechamento

• Identificar dores reais relacionadas a acessos privilegiados, identidade, compliance e risco operacional

• Trabalhar de forma consultiva, traduzindo conceitos técnicos de cibersegurança em valor de negócio

• Atuar em conjunto com times de pré-vendas e engenharia para construção de propostas técnicas e comerciais

• Desenvolver e manter um pipeline previsível, com foco em resultados e recorrência

• Apoiar a construção da estratégia de entrada e posicionamento da Cybervision no Brasil

• Manter relacionamento próximo com decisores (CIO, CISO, CTO, Segurança, Infra e Risco)


Requisitos Obrigatórios

• Experiência comprovada como Account Executive ou Hunter B2B em tecnologia ou cibersegurança

• Domínio de conceitos de cibersegurança, especialmente:

• PAM (Privileged Access Management)

• IAM / Identity

• Acesso remoto seguro

• Compliance (ISO 27001, LGPD, SOX – diferencial)

• Capacidade de conduzir vendas complexas e consultivas

• Forte habilidade de comunicação com públicos técnicos e executivos

• Perfil hunter, orientado a metas e crescimento

• Autonomia, disciplina e visão estratégica de mercado

• Inglês


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios)

• Experiência com soluções de PAM, ZTNA, Zero Trust etc…

• Carteira ativa de contatos em TI, Segurança da Informação ou Infraestrutura

• Vivência em vendas de SaaS B2B



 O que oferecemos

• Atuação em um produto estratégico e de alto valor no mercado de cibersegurança

• Autonomia real para construir mercado e gerar impacto

• Modelo de remuneração competitivo (fixo + variável)

• Possibilidade de crescimento junto com a expansão da Cybervision no Brasil

• Contato direto com liderança e participação ativa na estratégia da empresa



Perfil que buscamos


  • Buscamos alguém que entenda segurança de verdade, saiba vender valor (não apenas produto) e queira fazer parte da construção de uma nova referência em PAM no Brasil.

title: Founder / Implementation Partner - Brazil
description:
About Lua


Lua is a YC-backed enterprise work management platform that's changing how organisations run. We replace the patchwork of spreadsheets, project tools, and disconnected systems that most companies use to manage their operations, with a single, unified AI platform that connects strategy to execution.


Our clients include some of the world's largest enterprises across financial services, healthcare, government, and professional services. They choose Lua because it gives them visibility they've never had before, the ability to see exactly what's happening across their organisation, in real time, and to make decisions based on reality rather than guesswork.


The product sells. Enterprises are actively looking for solutions like Lua, and when they see it, they get it. Your job is to find them, show them what's possible, and deliver implementations that transform how they work.


Learn more at our website,


The Opportunity


We're looking for entrepreneurs to build and own exclusive Lua implementation agencies in markets around the world. This isn't a job, it's a funded business opportunity. You'll own 100% of your agency, keep the profits, and have exclusive rights to your territory.


We provide the startup capital, the product, and the training. You provide the ambition, the local expertise, and the execution. If you've ever wanted to run your own business but lacked the capital or the product to sell, this is it.


What You'll Do


Build your business. 

You'll start from zero and build a Lua implementation practice in Brazil. That means finding clients, closing deals, hiring a team, and delivering implementations that make clients successful.


Own the market. 

You'll have exclusive rights to Brazil. No other Lua agency will compete with you. Every Lua deal in your market is yours to win.


Deliver results. 

You'll implement Lua for enterprise clients, configuring the platform, migrating data, training users, and providing ongoing support. Your success is measured by client outcomes, not hours billed.


Keep the profits. 

You own 100% of your agency. After repaying the initial capital (interest free), everything you earn is yours.


What You'll Get


Startup funding

Interest-free capital to cover your first 6 months, salary, team, setup costs


Exclusive territory

Sole rights to sell and deliver Lua in Brazil, no internal competition


Product + training

Full certification on Lua, sales enablement, implementation playbooks, ongoing support


100% ownership

You own your agency outright, no equity given up, no franchise fees, no royalties


Lead flow

Access to Lua's inbound pipeline and marketing support in your region



What We're Looking For


Candidates should have at least some of the skills, qualities, and background outlined below:


Analytical foundation. 

You have a STEM background or similar analytical training. You're comfortable with data, systems thinking, and technical concepts. Lua is a sophisticated platform, you need to understand it deeply to sell and deliver it effectively.


Enterprise experience. 

You've sold to or delivered for large organisations. You understand how enterprises buy, how decisions get made, and how to navigate complex stakeholder environments.


Consulting or implementation background.

You've done the work, configured platforms, run workshops, managed client relationships, delivered projects. Ideally in work management, PPM, ERP, or similar enterprise software.


Local market knowledge. 

You know your market, the industries, the companies, the way business gets done. You have relationships you can activate or know how to build them quickly.


Builder mentality. 

You want to create something, not just execute someone else's playbook. You're comfortable with ambiguity, energised by ownership, and motivated by building a business that's yours.


Skin in the game. 

You're willing to commit fully, this is not a side project. You'll repay the startup funding from your implementation revenue, which means you need to believe in your ability to deliver.


Fluent in English & Portuguese.  

You’re able to communicate at a business level both with Lua and with the clients in Brazil.


The Deal


We fund your first 6 months. You focus 100% on Lua, no other products, no consulting on the side. Starting month 7, you repay the funding at 20% of implementation revenue until it's paid back. After that, everything you earn is yours.


If you hit your targets, you'll have a profitable business within your first year and exclusive ownership of a growing market. If you don't, we part ways, you keep what you've built, we find another partner.


If you're ready to build something of your own, backed by a product enterprises want and funding to get started, we want to hear from you!

title: Country Manager Brazil
description:
We are a global infrastructure company delivering a proven, proprietary technology that is transforming the way large-scale infrastructure projects are built — faster, more cost-effective, and significantly more environmentally friendly.

For over 30 years, our technology has been successfully implemented in thousands of projects across more than 80 countries worldwide.

We are currently seeking an experienced Brazil, driving market development and the successful delivery of our solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead business development efforts by developing new markets and expanding existing ones
  • Drive the end-to-end implementation of our solution, from initial planning and opportunity analysis through execution and delivery
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, ensuring high satisfaction, successful project outcomes, and the creation of case studies and testimonials
  • Promote long-term customer retention and generate repeat business opportunities
  • Act as the local ambassador for the company, representing our technology with key stakeholders and decision-makers


Profile & Experience

  • At least 10 years of experience in infrastructure project management within the civil engineering sector, with a strong preference for road and/or railway construction
  • Proven track record of working with construction companies, contractors, supervisors, engineering firms, project managers, and government authorities
  • Deep understanding of infrastructure project cost structures, with the ability to identify where our solution delivers maximum value
  • Established professional network with the ability to open doors and expand business reach
  • Strong presentation and communication skills, with the ability to influence and gain trust through professional expertise
  • A natural people person — attentive, detail-oriented, approachable, and relationship-driven


Additional Requirements

  • Willingness to travel extensively, including site visits, for approximately 50% of the role
  • Licensed Civil Engineer — mandatory

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior
description:
Cargo

Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior


Responsabilidades

• Desenvolver, manter e evoluir aplicações backend e frontend para plataformas de gateway de pagamentos e soluções whitelabel.

• Projetar, implementar e sustentar integrações com adquirentes, subadquirentes, PSPs e serviços financeiros via APIs.

• Garantir estabilidade, performance e segurança de fluxos críticos de pagamento.

• Diagnosticar e resolver incidentes técnicos que impactem transações, conciliação e disponibilidade do sistema.

• Evoluir sistemas legados com responsabilidade técnica, minimizando riscos operacionais.

• Contribuir para decisões técnicas relacionadas a escalabilidade, alta disponibilidade e resiliência.

• Garantir padrões de código, arquitetura e boas práticas em ambientes regulados e de missão crítica.


Competências

• Visão sistêmica de plataformas financeiras e fluxos transacionais.

• Capacidade de análise e resolução de problemas em ambientes de alta criticidade.

• Autonomia e senso de responsabilidade sobre sistemas em produção.

• Comunicação técnica clara para interação com times de produto, operação e negócio.

• Postura pragmática e orientada à estabilidade e previsibilidade.


Exigências técnicas

• Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento backend e frontend.

• Domínio de APIs REST e integrações complexas entre sistemas.

• Experiência com gateways de pagamento, meios de pagamento ou plataformas financeiras.

• Conhecimento de fluxos de autorização, captura, cancelamento, estorno e conciliação.

• Vivência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais.

• Experiência com ambientes Linux, controle de versões e pipelines de deploy.

• Noções de segurança, disponibilidade e tolerância a falhas em sistemas financeiros.


Experiência

• Atuação prévia como Desenvolvedor Full Stack Sênior ou função equivalente.

• Experiência comprovada em plataformas de pagamento, fintechs ou soluções whitelabel.

• Vivência em ambientes de produção com alta disponibilidade e impacto direto no negócio.

title: Redator(a) Criativo(a)
description:
Estamos contratando Redator(a) Criativo(a) no Brasil!


Na UFILMS, estamos em busca de um(a) Redator(a) Criativo(a) com ideias frescas, pensamento estratégico e muita paixão por contar histórias. Se você ama criar conceitos e escrever pensando em audiências digitais, queremos te conhecer!


Se você também tem experiência criando conteúdo para plataformas de streaming, é um grande diferencial.


O que esperamos de você:


✅ Experiência comprovada como Redator(a) Criativo(a) em agências, produtoras ou meios digitais.

✅ Criatividade para desenvolver conceitos, campanhas e narrativas para diferentes plataformas e formatos.

✅ Excelente redação e adaptação de tom de acordo com a marca e o público.

✅ Conhecimento de tendências digitais e do universo do entretenimento.

✅ Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe com diretores criativos, designers e editores.

✅ Disponibilidade para trabalhar de forma remota ou híbrida a partir do Brasil.


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios):


➕ Experiência com plataformas de streaming ou projetos de entretenimento.

➕ Vivência em campanhas de lançamento de séries ou filmes.

➕ Inglês intermediário/avançado.


O que oferecemos:


✨ Projetos criativos para marcas de alto nível.

✨ Um time talentoso e colaborativo.

✨ Modalidade de trabalho flexível.

✨ Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.


Se você é essa pessoa criativa que estamos procurando, envie seu CV (mencionando o cargo ao qual está se candidatando) e portfólio para

Queremos conhecer suas ideias!

Estamos contratando Redator(a) Criativo(a) no Brasil!


Na UFILMS, estamos em busca de um(a) Redator(a) Criativo(a) com ideias frescas, pensamento estratégico e muita paixão por contar histórias. Se você ama criar conceitos e escrever pensando em audiências digitais, queremos te conhecer!


Se você também tem experiência criando conteúdo para plataformas de streaming, é um grande diferencial.


O que esperamos de você:


✅ Experiência comprovada como Redator(a) Criativo(a) em agências, produtoras ou meios digitais.

✅ Criatividade para desenvolver conceitos, campanhas e narrativas para diferentes plataformas e formatos.

✅ Excelente redação e adaptação de tom de acordo com a marca e o público.

✅ Conhecimento de tendências digitais e do universo do entretenimento.

✅ Capacidade de trabalhar em equipe com diretores criativos, designers e editores.

✅ Disponibilidade para trabalhar de forma remota ou híbrida a partir do Brasil.


Diferenciais (não obrigatórios):


➕ Experiência com plataformas de streaming ou projetos de entretenimento.

➕ Vivência em campanhas de lançamento de séries ou filmes.

➕ Inglês intermediário/avançado.


O que oferecemos:


✨ Projetos criativos para marcas de alto nível.

✨ Um time talentoso e colaborativo.

✨ Modalidade de trabalho flexível.

✨ Oportunidades de crescimento e desenvolvimento profissional.


Se você é essa pessoa criativa que estamos procurando, envie seu CV (mencionando o cargo ao qual está se candidatando) e portfólio para

Queremos conhecer suas ideias!

title: Consultor de vendas
description:
Descrição da Empresa A Connecta Networking é uma empresa fornecedora de soluções de Tecnologia da Informação e Telecomunicações para impulsionar a transformação digital de seus clientes corporativos. Integramos nossos produtos e serviços de Provedor de Internet B2B, com as soluções dos maiores e melhores fabricantes de tecnologia do mundo, como (Fortinet, Extreme Networks, Cisco, HPE, dentre outros).

Descrição do Cargo Estamos buscando um Consultor de Vendas para se juntar à nossa equipe em Belém, PA. Este cargo envolve atividades diárias, como prospectar novos clientes, gerenciar atendimento de contas atuais, realizar apresentações de vendas, negociar contratos e garantir a satisfação dos clientes. O consultor será responsável por oferecer soluções do portfólio da empresa ou soluções personalizadas, que atendam as necessidades dos clientes, além de ser o ponto focal para a satisfação do mesmo. Este é um cargo de tempo integral e requer presença no local.

Qualificações

  • Consultoria de Vendas: Necessário ter experiência em consultoria de vendas B2B com produtos de tecnologia e/ou telecom, capacidade de desenvolver estratégias eficazes de vendas.
  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Habilidades em atendimento ao cliente e consultoria são essenciais para garantir a satisfação e fidelização dos clientes.
  • Comunicação: Deve possuir excelentes habilidades de comunicação, tanto verbalmente quanto por escrito, para interagir de forma eficaz com os clientes e a equipe.
  • Formação: Desejável formação técnica em tecnologia da informação, telecomunicações ou áreas afins. Necessário conhecimento de serviços e produtos de TI/Telecom.

title: Desenvolvedor Java
description:
BRQ WAY

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


Ei Profissional venha fazer parte de uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país!



  • O que procuramos?

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


  • O que você deve ter?

Conhecimento avançado em Java e imprescindivel ter conhecimento em IA (o Copilot , CURSOR) \" para desenvolvimento\"; Se Tiver Ingles é um diferencial -------- Experiência em AWS, Banco de dados (Oracle, SQL Server), bons Conhecimento JBoss Message Queue Formação completa, preferencialmente em Engenharia, Informática ou áreas relacionadas; Capacidade de organização com múltiplas atividades e requisições simultâneas; Capacidade de comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal para endereçar problemas e discutir soluções com as áreas envolvidas; Raciocínio lógico, capacidade analítica e de organização; Descrição da área: A área é responsável pela plataforma utilizada pelo time de BackOffice para batimento de boletas, custódia e caixa, além da alocação/execução/confirmação dos trades, valuation e settlement. Atuamos no desenvolvimento de melhorias operacionais e incorporação de novos produtos financeiros na plataforma, que é desenvolvida em Java e hospedada na cloud AWS.



O que temos pra te oferecer?

Mais do que um plano de carreira!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 etapas:

- Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

- Mobilidade Interna: Você quer um novo rumo profissional? Aqui dentro de casa temos diversas opções diferentes e o programa de mobilidade interna, que te permite mudar de área, por exemplo.

- Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

- Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Home Office; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions

Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

description:
VAGA – CONFIRMAÇÃO DE PEDIDOS (FULL TIME | HOME OFFICE) - Espanhol Fluente

Somos uma empresa pequena , porém com cultura forte, organização e grande potencial de crescimento . Buscamos uma pessoa comprometida, responsável e focada para atuar na confirmação de pedidos .

Função

Entrar em contato com clientes para:

  • Corrigir endereço incompleto
  • Resolver falta de resposta
  • Ajustar pendências no transporte
  • Solucionar qualquer problema que impeça a entrega do pedido

O trabalho é feito por mensagens e ligações, portanto é obrigatório espanhol fluente, especialmente na fala .

Atenção – leitura obrigatória

O trabalho é HOME OFFICE , porém:

  • Não é trabalho flexível
  • Não é por tarefa
  • Não permite iniciar qualquer hora, parar qualquer hora, exige uma rotina
  • Não permite outros empregos, freelas ou atividades paralelas

Se você acredita que por ser home office pode trabalhar de qualquer forma, em qualquer horário ou conciliando outros trabalhos, este definitivamente não é o lugar para você .

Requisitos obrigatórios
  • Espanhol fluente (fala clara e segura)
  • Disponibilidade FULL TIME
  • Total foco e comprometimento com a empresa
Nossa cultura (INEGOCIÁVEL)
  • Honestidade
  • Respeito
  • Responsabilidade
  • Cumprir exatamente o que foi combinado
Remuneração
  • Salário fixo: R$ 1.900
  • Bônus + metas

Buscamos alguém que queira crescer junto , assumir responsabilidade e fazer parte de um time sério.

title: Coordenador de Planejamento e Análise Financeira
description:
Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Juntos, alcançaremos nosso objetivos.

Estamos com oportunidades para pessoas com deficiência para todo o grupo.

Descrição Breve do Cargo:

  • Coordenar as atividades de acompanhamento mensal do resultado das empresas (real vs orçado / forecast),
  • Garantindo qualidade das análises e consistência das informações financeiras e o suporte efetivo à tomada de decisão gerencial, identificando desvios, causas e impactos.
  • Coordenar o processo de orçamento anual, assegurando prazos, premissas e alinhamento com a estratégia da empresa.
  • Liderar a elaboração de forecasts periódicos, incluindo revisão de premissas e consolidação das informações das áreas de negócio.
  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais e dashboards claros, consistentes e direcionados à liderança.
  • Atuar como parceiro das áreas operacionais, promovendo entendimento financeiro e suporte às decisões de negócio.
  • Contribuir para a melhoria contínua de processos, automação de rotinas e evolução dos indicadores financeiros.
  • Demais atividades conforme solicitação do Gestor Imediato.

Instrução:

  • Ensino Superior Completo Em Contabilidade, Administração ou Áreas afins.

Sobre a Agropalma

A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. Guiada pelo compromisso com o planeta e as pessoas, a empresa segue avançando em suas práticas para tornar a palma sustentável uma referência brasileira. Para mais informações, acesse:

description:
About You

You are a technical, AI-enabled Business Analyst who thrives in complex, integration-driven environments. You feel comfortable operating within mature platforms that support a growing ecosystem of external technology partners.

You are highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive in communication. You are curious about AI capabilities and comfortable experimenting with prompt-driven solutions to improve documentation, workflows, and integrations. You prioritize progress over perfection and are able to move initiatives forward even when not all variables are fully defined.

You work autonomously, take ownership of outcomes, and stay highly engaged in delivery and execution.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience as a Technical Business Analyst supporting integration-heavy platforms.
  • Strong experience collaborating closely with Engineering teams in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Hands-on experience managing backlogs using Azure DevOps, Jira, or similar tools.
  • Advanced understanding of APIs and web technologies, including REST, JSON, authentication, error handling, and request/response flows.
  • Experience reviewing logs, analyzing defects, and supporting production issue triage.
  • Experience onboarding and supporting external API or integration partners.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate autonomously within self-managed Agile teams.
  • Proven experience leveraging AI tools to enhance documentation, analysis, or workflow efficiency.
  • Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Full professional proficiency in English.
  • Familiarity with Azure cloud environments.
  • Exposure to middleware, API platforms, or integration layers.
  • Experience improving onboarding or operational workflows through automation (nice to have, embedded as we usually do).


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the primary coordination point between Engineering teams and external API/integration partners.
  • Own the intake, triage, prioritization, and assignment of technical defects and enhancement requests.
  • Translate business and partner needs into detailed technical requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
  • Support the onboarding of new integration partners, including requirement validation, credential setup, testing coordination, certification, and go-live support.
  • Collaborate with Engineering to analyze API logs, error patterns, and production issues to determine root causes and define next steps.
  • Maintain and groom integration-related backlogs, ensuring clarity, prioritization, and delivery alignment.
  • Coordinate UAT and partner validation activities.
  • Track dependencies, risks, and delivery progress across concurrent initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to improve onboarding, issue triage, and integration processes through standardization and AI-driven efficiencies.
  • Ensure delivered solutions meet technical constraints, business objectives, and partner expectations.


Qualifications

  • Technical Business Analyst in Agile environments, supporting API integrations (REST, JSON, Authentication, Error Handling), backlog management (Azure DevOps / Jira), defect triage, and production support.
  • Experience supporting external API partners, collaborating cross-functionally with Engineering teams, and leveraging AI tools to enhance documentation, analysis, and workflow efficiency.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Remote Biomedical Informatics SME - 58854
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

We are seeking highly skilled Biomedical Informatics Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to join our team in developing rigorous, high-quality evaluation questions designed to assess and challenge advanced AI models. The primary objective is to create benchmark questions that test the boundaries of AI capabilities across diverse bioinformatics domains.

This role requires deep technical expertise combined with the ability to craft precise, unambiguous questions with well-defined evaluations. The ideal candidate will possess not only strong theoretical knowledge but also practical experience in designing assessment materials that have deterministic, verifiable outcomes.


Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop challenging bioinformatics coding questions that push the limits of AI model capabilities.
  • Create automated, coding-based evaluations with unit tests that objectively verify correctness.
  • Build comprehensive evaluation rubrics with 7–10 distinct criteria for each bioinformatics question.
  • Ensure every question is self-contained, well-defined, and completely unambiguous, including all domain rules and edge cases.
  • Develop problems where there is exactly one correct answer or outcome that can be deterministically validated.
  • Translate theoretical bioinformatics concepts into concrete, measurable outputs.
  • Enforce performance requirements with explicit constraints and tests to prevent inefficient or brute-force solutions.


Required Qualifications:

Educational Background

  • Master's degree of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • Ongoing PhD with 3+ years of experience in biomedical data processing and interpretation.
  • PhD (completed) in Biomedical Informatics, Bioinformatics, Computational Biology or a closely related field (preferred).


Technical and other skills

  • Strong proficiency in biomedical data processing, analysis, and interpretation , including working with large‑scale datasets.
  • Experience with bioinformatics tools and pipelines (e.g., NGS workflows, multi‑omics, etc.).
  • Solid programming skills in Python / R
  • Experience working in Linux/Unix , Docker and version control.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills for working in interdisciplinary research teams


Domain Expertise Requirements

Candidates must demonstrate deep, expert-level knowledge in at least TWO (2) of the following five core bioinformatics domains:

1. Biomedical Image Processing

  • Processing of Radiology imaging: CT, MRI, PET/SPECT, Ultrasound imaging
  • Automating cell counting, identifying cell types, and analyzing tissue structures in pathology slides
  • Computational segmentation and boundary inference
  • Medical image formation, reconstruction & enhancement
  • Noise modeling and statistical denoising
  • Image sampling theory and resolution limits
  • Intensity standardization and harmonization
  • Geometric transformations and spatial calibration
  • Multi-modal image registration and alignment
  • Morphological and topological shape analysis
  • Quantitative imaging feature extraction
  • Fusing data from different modalities (MRI, PET, Genomics) for a comprehensive view to tailor treatments
  • pattern recognition and predictive modeling

2. Biomedical Signal Processing

  • Cardiovascular/hemodynamic signals (ECG, PPG, BP, HRV, etc)
  • Neural/brain electrical signals (EEG, EP/ERP; seizure/cognitive analysis)
  • Neuromuscular/motor signals (EMG, motor unit decomposition; prosthetics/rehab)
  • Ocular/visual system signals (EOG, blink/saccade analysis)
  • Respiratory signals (airflow, effort; sleep/disordered breathing)
  • Nonlinear, Statistical, and Adaptive Signal Analysis
  • Multichannel, Spatial, and Connectivity Signal Analysis
  • Machine Learning and Data‑Driven Biomedical Signal Analysis
  • Clinical Monitoring, Wearable, and Translational Signal Processing

3. Molecular & Omics based Personalized Medicine

  • Omics based risk / disease prediction (GWAS, PRS, bulk, single‑cell RNA‑seq, proteins / metabolite signatures associated with diseases)
  • Risk Prediction and Prognosis Modeling
  • Molecular patient subtyping
  • Liquid Biopsy and Circulating Biomarkers (ctDNA, cfRNA/miRNA, MRD, etc.)
  • Causal Inference & Mechanistic Inference (ATE/CATE, Trial emulation and counterfactual modeling)
  • Cross‑modal data fusion (omics + EHR + imaging / signals)
  • Longitudinal Patient Modeling and Disease Progression
  • Patient Stratification and Subtyping (molecular subtypes, endotypes)
  • Electronic Health Records and Clinical Data Science

4. Drug Discovery & Repurposing

  • Treatment response prediction
  • Structure-based drug design (Molecular docking, binding site analysis, Virtual screening workflow)
  • Protein structure analysis (PDB/mmCIF handling)
  • Chemoinformatics ( Ligand-based screening, molecular fingerprinting, 2D/3D data handling and chemical space analysis)
  • QSAR & ADMET Modeling
  • Drug–target interaction prediction
  • Drug sensitivity prediction in disease models
  • Repurposing via omics/network associations
  • Predictive Modeling for Drug Discovery Molecular Dynamics Simulation of Biomolecules (QM, DFT, stability, reactivity, PCA analysis )

5. Software / Utilities

  • Tool installation & environment management (docker/conda/pip)
  • Format conversion/validation (FASTA/FASTQ, BAM/VCF, PDB)
  • GUI-driven analysis workflows (step-by-step runs)
  • Workflow automation (scripts wrapping GUI tools)
  • Visualization tools (genome browsers, 3D viewers)
  • Container/VM execution and troubleshooting
  • Batch processing and report generation
  • Pipeline interoperability checks
  • Reproducibility packaging (configs, manifests)
  • Debugging typical bioinformatics tool errors

6. Regulatory Science and Clinical Policies

  • FDA/EMA regulatory pathways
  • Clinical Practice Guidelines & Standards of Care (e.g., NCCN, AHA, etc.)
  • Diagnostic Biomarker & Therapeutic Use Constraints
  • Medical Scenario Reasoning (case vignettes, Differential diagnosis)
  • Data & Content Compliance
  • Ethical Use, Safety, and Harm Prevention
  • Model Use Governance & Auditability
  • Policy‑Aligned Language & Communication
  • Clinical validation and cohort generalization
  • Privacy‑preserving learning


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : At least 30 hours per week. (We have 2 options of time commitment: 30 hrs/week or 40 hrs/week)
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 2 months; (expected start date is next week)


Evaluation Process:

  • Take home Assessment on Biomedical Informatics (2-6 hours)
  • Delivery discussion(15-30mins)


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.


Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Senior FreeBSD Kernel Engineer (Performance & Monitoring)
description:
Project Description:

  • We are building a team to work on the FreeBSD Performance Monitoring Counter (PMC) framework, including hwmon, libpmc, and pmcstat.
  • The project includes development, testing, and cooperation with the upstream FreeBSD open-source community to integrate new features into FreeBSD.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and improve parts of the FreeBSD PMC framework (hwmon, libpmc, pmcstat)
  • Investigate and fix performance and monitoring issues in the FreeBSD kernel

  • Support performance monitoring tools for modern AMD (Zen era) hardware
  • Participate in code reviews and technical discussions


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 7 years of experience in relevant technical areas
  • Strong knowledge of FreeBSD kernel architecture and internals
  • Excellent C programming skills
  • Strong understanding of x86 microarchitecture
  • Very good knowledge of performance monitoring on modern x86 systems

title: Portuguese Customer Support (Remote, Part-Time)
description:
About the role:

We are seeking a detail-oriented Portuguese-speaking Customer Support Specialist to join our remote team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between our Portuguese-speaking users and our global operations team, ensuring world-class support via Zendesk while contributing to the localized growth of the Airbrush app.


What you will do:

  • Customer Interaction: Handle Portuguese user inquiries (including some English tickets) via the Zendesk support system, providing efficient and professional assistance.
  • Issue Tracking: Document and organize user feedback and technical issues, ensuring they are synced with the User Operations team in a timely manner.
  • Team Collaboration: Maintain close communication with the User Operations team to assist in following up on and resolving complex cases.


Who we're looking for:

  • Language Proficiency: Major in Portuguese or equivalent proficiency; excellent written and verbal Portuguese skills are required. Strong written English or Chinese proficiency is a HUGE PLUS.
  • Experience: Prior experience in customer service, online support, or related fields is preferred.
  • Soft Skills: Detail-oriented, patient, and highly responsible.



Work Schedule:

  • Commitment: 6 days per week, approximately 2 hours per day (flexible by ±1 hour depending on ticket volume).
  • Flexibility: Remote position with flexible hours; however, you must ensure timely responses (all inquiries must be addressed within 24 hours).


About Meitu

Founded in 2008, Meitu is an AI-driven technology company that regards \"beauty\" as its core ideal. Guided by our mission to \"Uniting Art and Technology\", Meitu is committed to creating world-class imaging products that simplify the creation of images, videos, designs, and other visual content.

Meitu was listed in 2016 on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange(stock code 1357.HK). As of June 30, 2025, Meitu had 280 million global monthly active users, including 98 million from regions and countries outside Mainland China.

We are an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, or veteran status.

At Meitu, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

title: IT Software License Specialist | Software Asset Management | Enterprise Architecture | ServiceNow SAM
description:
Role: IT Software License Specialist

Position Type: Full-Time Contract (40hrs/week)

Contract Duration: 6 Months+ (with a possibility of extension)

Work Hours: UST Time

Work Schedule: 8 hours/day (Mon-Fri)

Location: 100% Remote


Join our Software Asset Management (SAM) team under Enterprise Architecture and help drive license compliance, cost optimization, and effective software governance.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Analyze software usage to identify underutilized licenses and cost-saving opportunities
  • Manage license tracking, entitlements, and usage across systems
  • Support internal/external software audits and license compliance
  • Assist with budgeting, forecasting, and license procurement
  • Work with SAM tools (ServiceNow) and vendor software portals
  • Create reports and dashboards for stakeholders


Requirements:

  • 14 years of relevant experience
  • Associate’s degree required; Bachelor’s preferred (IT/CS or related)
  • Strong understanding of software licensing and SAM methodologies
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and collaboration skills
  • Experience with ServiceNow Software Asset Management preferred

title: Java Fullstack Developer (Angular)
description:
About You

You are a software engineer who enjoys building robust, scalable, and well-structured applications. You’re motivated by clean architecture, modern technologies, and meaningful collaboration across backend and frontend layers. You’re looking for a place where you can grow professionally, influence technical decisions, and contribute to high-impact products used by real customers.


You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 4+ years of professional experience developing backend solutions using Java (21+) and Spring Boot.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining monolithic backend applications following clean architecture principles.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and in-memory data stores such as Redis.
  • Proven experience working with AWS services, including S3, ECS, CloudWatch, and Bedrock.
  • Experience using MyBatis as an ORM and Liquibase for database versioning and migrations.
  • 2+ years of professional experience with Angular (v19 or similar), with strong usage of RxJS and Observables.
  • Familiarity with frontend monolith architectures and modern client-side frameworks.
  • Advanced knowledge of Git and version control best practices.
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.


You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Participate in collaborative concept definition, architectural refinement, and software design across backend and frontend layers.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable monolithic applications using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate them with Angular frontend applications using RxJS and Observables.
  • Implement and manage data persistence using PostgreSQL, MyBatis, Liquibase, and Redis.
  • Work with AWS infrastructure services (S3, ECS, CloudWatch, Bedrock) to support application deployment, monitoring, and observability.
  • Follow Agile practices, working independently while collaborating closely with a cross-functional team.
  • Maintain high-quality technical documentation throughout the SDLC.


Additional Information

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

About Us


At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.


We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.


Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Coordenador(a) de vendas - Idiomas
description:
Estamos buscando um(a) Coordenador(a) de Vendas para assumir a liderança estratégica do nosso time comercial.

Essa pessoa será a dona do time de vendas, responsável por acompanhar vendedores, melhorar processos, treinar o time, implementar novas estratégias comerciais e aumentar consistentemente os resultados.

É uma vaga para quem ama vendas, performance, organização, estratégia e desenvolvimento de pessoas.

Conheça nosso perfil no Instagram: @carolminchuerri


Sobre a Missão Alemão

Somos uma empresa dedicada ao ensino da língua alemã, com mais de 6 anos de experiência, com atuação em cursos online e comprometida com resultados reais dos alunos. Nosso objetivo é garantir que cada aluno avance, conclua o curso e tenha uma experiência excepcional durante toda a jornada conosco.


Responsabilidades

• Liderar, treinar e desenvolver o time de vendas

• Acompanhar performance individual e do time

• Criar e otimizar processos comerciais (scripts, cadências, rotinas e playbooks)

• Implementar estratégias para aumento de conversão e faturamento

• Cobrar metas com clareza e inteligência emocional

• Analisar indicadores e propor melhorias contínuas

• Garantir organização, disciplina e padrão de excelência no time


Requisitos

• Experiência comprovada em vendas, preferencialmente em ambiente digital ou operação online

• Experiência liderando times de vendas

• Capacidade de estruturar e melhorar processos comerciais

• Domínio de indicadores de vendas

• Experiência prática com feedbacks, cobrança de metas e desenvolvimento de vendedores

• Perfil analítico e orientado a dados

• Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal

• Senso de dono e alta responsabilidade por resultados

• Organização, disciplina e visão estratégica

• Disponibilidade para trabalho remoto em tempo integral


Modelo de Trabalho e Benefícios

• Regime PJ

• 100% Home Office

• Salário a combinar

• P.P.R. – Programa de Participação nos Resultados


Você tem esse perfil? Aguardamos sua candidatura para que juntos possamos levar a língua alemã para mais e mais pessoas que desejam realizar sonhos através do idioma.

title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
About Growave

Growave is a Shopify retention platform that helps brands grow through Loyalty & Rewards, Referrals, Wishlist, Reviews, and Instagram UGC. Thousands of merchants worldwide use Growave, including Lego, Crocs, Dermalogica, Unilever, Sony, and Aldo.


The Role

We’re looking for a Technical Support Specialist to help Shopify merchants get the most out of Growave. You’ll troubleshoot technical issues, customize Shopify themes, and work closely with Product and Engineering teams to deliver smooth solutions.


Employment Type

Contractor (Contract) – you are responsible for your own taxes and social contributions.


Responsibilities

  • Troubleshoot technical issues on Shopify storefronts
  • Customize Shopify themes (Liquid) for Growave widgets and integrations
  • Communicate with clients via Intercom, email, and calls
  • Create and edit scripts for Reviews, Loyalty, and Wishlist features
  • Debug client-side issues using browser developer tools
  • Collaborate with Developers on complex technical cases
  • Read and modify code in Shopify + Growave environment


Requirements

  • 1+ year of experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • Shopify theme customization experience (Liquid)
  • Familiarity with Shopify apps and ecosystem
  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills
  • Strong communication and self-management skills


Languages

  • English and Portuguese (required )
  • Additional languages are a plus


What We Offer

  • Fully remote work
  • Paid vacation and public holidays in your country
  • Work on a fast-growing global Shopify product
  • Collaboration with an experienced international team

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Na Ambra, buscamos um(a) DevOps Engineer que transforme complexidade em confiabilidade. Você vai atuar na construção e evolução de infraestruturas escaláveis, automatizadas e seguras, sendo peça-chave para a estabilidade e performance dos nossos produtos. Se você gosta de resolver problemas, automatizar processos e garantir que tudo funcione de forma fluida nos bastidores, essa vaga é pra você.


Objetivo

Planejar, implementar e administrar soluções de infraestrutura em cloud, observando aspectos de segurança, performance, governança e custo.


Responsabilidades
  • Planejar, implementar e administrar clusters Kubernetes no Azure (AKS).
  • Atuar com Docker no suporte ao desenvolvimento, pipelines e criação de imagens base.
  • Planejar e implementar projetos de CI/CD em conjunto com os desenvolvedores, utilizando Azure DevOps.
  • Implementar ferramentas de monitoramento de serviços e infraestrutura.
  • Acompanhar logs, traces e observabilidade por meio do Datadog.
  • Participar de processos de suporte ao time de desenvolvimento e de implantações, quando necessário.
  • Gerenciar ambientes Linux.
  • Contribuir com novas ideias, propostas e melhorias nos processos de DevOps, CI/CD e na estrutura dos ambientes.


Conhecimentos obrigatórios
  • AKS (Azure)
  • Helm
  • Pipelines e Releases no Azure DevOps
  • Administração de sistemas Linux
  • Docker
  • Git


Diferenciais
  • Terraform
  • ECS / Fargate (AWS)
  • Postman, Insomnia ou Swagger (testes de APIs REST)
  • Configuração de Apache
  • AWS CLI
  • Azure CLI
  • Shell Script
  • Noções de PHP / Laravel
  • Noções de Python / FastAPI
  • Capacidade de entendimento da arquitetura de microserviços, APIs e componentes de infraestrutura

Se você gosta de resolver problemas, automatizar processos e garantir que tudo funcione de forma fluida nos bastidores, essa vaga é pra você.


Objetivo

Planejar, implementar e administrar soluções de infraestrutura em cloud, observando aspectos de segurança, performance, governança e custo.


Responsabilidades
  • Planejar, implementar e administrar clusters Kubernetes no Azure (AKS).
  • Atuar com Docker no suporte ao desenvolvimento, pipelines e criação de imagens base.
  • Planejar e implementar projetos de CI/CD em conjunto com os desenvolvedores, utilizando Azure DevOps.
  • Implementar ferramentas de monitoramento de serviços e infraestrutura.
  • Acompanhar logs, traces e observabilidade por meio do Datadog.
  • Participar de processos de suporte ao time de desenvolvimento e de implantações, quando necessário.
  • Gerenciar ambientes Linux.
  • Contribuir com novas ideias, propostas e melhorias nos processos de DevOps, CI/CD e na estrutura dos ambientes.


Conhecimentos obrigatórios
  • AKS (Azure)
  • Helm
  • Pipelines e Releases no Azure DevOps
  • Administração de sistemas Linux
  • Docker
  • Git


Diferenciais
  • Terraform
  • ECS / Fargate (AWS)
  • Postman, Insomnia ou Swagger (testes de APIs REST)
  • Configuração de Apache
  • AWS CLI
  • Azure CLI
  • Shell Script
  • Noções de PHP / Laravel
  • Noções de Python / FastAPI
  • Capacidade de entendimento da arquitetura de microserviços, APIs e componentes de infraestrutura

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
The Opportunity We are an investment firm building a next-generation \"AI Operating System\" to power our deal flow and investor relations. We are looking for a Low-Code Engineer who can own our operations stack.


We aren't looking for someone to just connect simple triggers (Zapier-style). We need an architect who can build complex, multi-step workflows that fetch unstructured data (call transcripts, email history), process it via LLMs (Claude/GPT), and execute high-stakes communications with precision.


What You Will Build (General Scope)

  • AI-Driven Communications: Workflows that draft hyper-personalized emails to investors and clients by referencing historical data and context.
  • Intelligent Reporting Loops: Systems that periodically query our database to aggregate activity logs and generate strategic summaries for stakeholders.
  • Data Synchronization: Ensuring seamless data flow between our CRM (Attio), Database (Supabase), and Deal Room (Airtable).
  • Contextual RAG: Building logic that pulls specific past interactions (transcripts) to inform future AI outputs.

The Tech Stack

  • Orchestration: n8n (Primary requirement).
  • Database: Supabase (PostgreSQL).
  • CRM: Attio & Airtable.
  • AI: Anthropic (Claude 3.5 Sonnet) & OpenAI APIs.

Who You Are

  • n8n Expert: You are comfortable using Code Nodes (JavaScript) to manipulate JSON data, handle error routing, and manage complex logic trees.
  • Data Literate: You are comfortable writing SQL queries (Supabase) to fetch, filter, and aggregate specific datasets (e.g., \"Fetch interactions from the last 48 hours\").
  • Prompt Engineer: You understand how to structure System vs. User prompts to prevent hallucinations and ensure strict formatting compliance.
  • Detail Oriented: We automate high-value interactions. You understand the importance of testing and \"kill-switches\" to prevent errors.
